# ============================================================
# SETTINGS YOU ARE MOST LIKELY TO CHANGE

analysis_year <- 2025

# A stock must have been purchased by at least this many different
# politicians to appear in the opening network. Using 2 matches the
# question "Who bought the same stocks?" because a stock enters only
# when at least two politicians connect to it.
min_politicians_per_stock <- 2

# Optional manual filename overrides. Leave NA to auto-detect files
# in the same folder as this Rmd.
ptr_file_override <- "PTR_transactions_2025_ACCEPTED_STOCK_PURCHASES.csv"

# Committee provenance and transaction-date matching for this project.
#
# Original dataset:
#   unitedstates/congress-legislators
#
# Development fork:
#   StrokeOfLuck/congress-legislators
#
# Instead of applying one committee snapshot to the entire year, this version
# uses every useful 2025 committee-membership snapshot published in the repo.
# Each PTR transaction is matched to the closest defensible House snapshot:
#   * Jan. 1-2, 2025 -> Dec. 17, 2024 (the latest usable 118th-Congress snapshot)
#   * Jan. 3-20, 2025 -> Jan. 21, 2025 (the first usable 119th-Congress House snapshot)
#   * Jan. 21 onward -> the latest available snapshot on or before the transaction
#
# The Jan. 17 repository update is documented but not used because it contained
# no House committee membership rows.
committee_source_repo <- "https://github.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators"
committee_fork_repo <- "https://github.com/StrokeOfLuck/congress-legislators"

committee_file_override <- "committee-membership-2025-TRANSACTION_MATCHED.csv"
committee_snapshot_index_file <- "committee-snapshot-index-2025.csv"
committee_reference_file <- "committee-membership-2025-TRANSACTION_MATCHED-REFERENCE.md"
house_roster_2025_cache_file <- "house-roster-119th-congress-2025.csv"

value_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  as.character(x[[1]])
}

normalize_party_early <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Democrat", "Democratic", "D") ~ "Democrat",
    x %in% c("Republican", "R") ~ "Republican",
    x %in% c("Independent", "I") ~ "Independent",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

read_pinned_yaml_url <- function(url_string) {
  con <- base::url(url_string, open = "rb")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)

  yaml_text <- paste(
    readLines(con, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  yaml::yaml.load(yaml_text)
}

github_raw_url <- function(commit_sha, path) {
  paste0(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators/",
    commit_sha,
    "/",
    path
  )
}

flatten_house_committee_snapshot <- function(
  snapshot_date_value,
  commit_sha
) {
  membership_list <- read_pinned_yaml_url(
    github_raw_url(
      commit_sha,
      "committee-membership-current.yaml"
    )
  )

  committee_list <- read_pinned_yaml_url(
    github_raw_url(
      commit_sha,
      "committees-current.yaml"
    )
  )

  committee_metadata <- bind_rows(
    lapply(committee_list, function(committee_entry) {
      committee_id_value <- value_or_na(
        committee_entry$thomas_id
      )
      committee_type_value <- value_or_na(
        committee_entry$type
      )
      committee_name_value <- value_or_na(
        committee_entry$name
      )

      parent_row <- tibble(
        committee_id = committee_id_value,
        committee_type = committee_type_value,
        committee_name = committee_name_value,
        committee_subcommittee_name = ""
      )

      subcommittee_rows <- tibble(
        committee_id = character(),
        committee_type = character(),
        committee_name = character(),
        committee_subcommittee_name = character()
      )

      if (
        !is.null(committee_entry$subcommittees) &&
        length(committee_entry$subcommittees) > 0
      ) {
        subcommittee_rows <- bind_rows(
          lapply(
            committee_entry$subcommittees,
            function(subcommittee_entry) {
              tibble(
                committee_id = paste0(
                  committee_id_value,
                  value_or_na(
                    subcommittee_entry$thomas_id
                  )
                ),
                committee_type = paste(
                  committee_type_value,
                  "subcommittee"
                ),
                committee_name = committee_name_value,
                committee_subcommittee_name =
                  value_or_na(subcommittee_entry$name)
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }

      bind_rows(parent_row, subcommittee_rows)
    })
  ) %>%
    distinct(
      committee_id,
      committee_type,
      committee_name,
      committee_subcommittee_name
    )

  membership_rows <- bind_rows(
    lapply(names(membership_list), function(committee_id_value) {
      members <- membership_list[[committee_id_value]]

      if (is.null(members) || length(members) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      bind_rows(
        lapply(members, function(member_entry) {
          tibble(
            bioguide = value_or_na(member_entry$bioguide),
            name = value_or_na(member_entry$name),
            committee_id = as.character(committee_id_value),
            membership_party = value_or_na(member_entry$party),
            title = value_or_na(member_entry$title),
            rank = suppressWarnings(
              as.integer(value_or_na(member_entry$rank))
            ),
            chamber = value_or_na(member_entry$chamber)
          )
        })
      )
    })
  )

  membership_rows %>%
    left_join(
      committee_metadata,
      by = "committee_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      tolower(trimws(as.character(committee_type))) %in%
        c("house", "house subcommittee")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      snapshot_date = as.Date(snapshot_date_value),
      source_commit = commit_sha
    ) %>%
    select(
      bioguide,
      name,
      committee_id,
      committee_type,
      committee_name,
      committee_subcommittee_name,
      membership_party,
      title,
      rank,
      chamber,
      snapshot_date,
      source_commit
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      committee_type,
      committee_id,
      rank,
      name
    )
}

build_committee_history <- function() {
  snapshots <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(committee_snapshot_index)),
    function(i) {
      snapshot_row <- committee_snapshot_index[i, ]

      message(
        "Fetching committee snapshot ",
        format(snapshot_row$snapshot_date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        " (",
        substr(snapshot_row$source_commit, 1, 7),
        ")..."
      )

      flatten_house_committee_snapshot(
        snapshot_row$snapshot_date,
        snapshot_row$source_commit
      )
    }
  )

  bind_rows(snapshots) %>%
    distinct(
      snapshot_date,
      source_commit,
      bioguide,
      committee_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      snapshot_date,
      committee_type,
      committee_id,
      rank,
      name
    )
}

if (!file.exists(committee_file_override)) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      committee_history_cache <- build_committee_history()

      if (nrow(committee_history_cache) == 0) {
        stop("No House committee rows were returned.")
      }

      readr::write_csv(
        committee_history_cache,
        committee_file_override
      )

      readr::write_csv(
        committee_snapshot_index %>%
          mutate(snapshot_date = as.character(snapshot_date)),
        committee_snapshot_index_file
      )

      message(
        "Saved ",
        format(nrow(committee_history_cache), big.mark = ","),
        " committee/subcommittee snapshot rows to ",
        committee_file_override
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Could not build the time-aware 2025 committee history. ",
          "The first render needs internet access to GitHub. ",
          "\nOriginal error: ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
} else if (!file.exists(committee_snapshot_index_file)) {
  readr::write_csv(
    committee_snapshot_index %>%
      mutate(snapshot_date = as.character(snapshot_date)),
    committee_snapshot_index_file
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 2025 HOUSE ROSTER FOR COVERAGE
# ----------------------------
# This is separate from committee matching. It lets the report distinguish:
#   1) politicians in the main shared-stock graph,
#   2) politicians with accepted 2025 stock purchases but outside that graph,
#   3) 2025 House members with no accepted purchase found by this project.
flatten_legislator_yaml <- function(legislator_list) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(legislator_list, function(person) {
      bioguide_value <- value_or_na(person$id$bioguide)

      official_name <- value_or_na(
        person$name$official_full
      )

      if (
        is.na(official_name) ||
        trimws(official_name) == ""
      ) {
        name_parts <- c(
          value_or_na(person$name$first),
          value_or_na(person$name$middle),
          value_or_na(person$name$last),
          value_or_na(person$name$suffix)
        )

        name_parts <- name_parts[
          !is.na(name_parts) &
          trimws(name_parts) != ""
        ]

        official_name <- paste(
          name_parts,
          collapse = " "
        )
      }

      terms <- person$terms

      if (is.null(terms) || length(terms) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      bind_rows(
        lapply(terms, function(term_entry) {
          tibble(
            bioguide = bioguide_value,
            full_name = official_name,
            type = value_or_na(term_entry$type),
            state = value_or_na(term_entry$state),
            district = suppressWarnings(
              as.integer(value_or_na(term_entry$district))
            ),
            party = normalize_party_early(
              value_or_na(term_entry$party)
            ),
            term_start = as.Date(
              value_or_na(term_entry$start)
            ),
            term_end = as.Date(
              value_or_na(term_entry$end)
            )
          )
        })
      )
    })
  )
}

build_2025_house_roster <- function() {
  current_legislators <- read_pinned_yaml_url(
    github_raw_url(
      house_roster_source_commit,
      "legislators-current.yaml"
    )
  )

  historical_legislators <- read_pinned_yaml_url(
    github_raw_url(
      house_roster_source_commit,
      "legislators-historical.yaml"
    )
  )

  bind_rows(
    flatten_legislator_yaml(current_legislators),
    flatten_legislator_yaml(historical_legislators)
  ) %>%
    filter(
      type == "rep",
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != "",
      !is.na(term_start),
      !is.na(term_end),
      term_start <= as.Date("2025-12-31"),
      term_end >= as.Date("2025-01-03")
    ) %>%
    group_by(bioguide) %>%
    summarise(
      full_name = dplyr::last(
        full_name[order(term_start)]
      ),
      state = dplyr::last(
        state[order(term_start)]
      ),
      district = dplyr::last(
        district[order(term_start)]
      ),
      party = dplyr::last(
        party[order(term_start)]
      ),
      first_2025_term_date = max(
        min(term_start, na.rm = TRUE),
        as.Date("2025-01-03")
      ),
      last_2025_term_date = min(
        max(term_end, na.rm = TRUE),
        as.Date("2025-12-31")
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(state, district, full_name)
}

if (!file.exists(house_roster_2025_cache_file)) {
  tryCatch(
    {

}

# ============================================================
# FILE DETECTION
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
# There may be several PTR_transactions CSVs in the folder. Older versions
# do not contain the cleaned V8.2 fields used by this project, so do NOT just
# take the first filename returned by list.files(). Check each candidate's
# header and choose a compatible file automatically.

required_ptr_columns_for_detection <- c(
  "politician",
  "asset_type",
  "transaction_type",
  "transaction_date",
  "ticker_v8_2_cleaned",
  "ticker_parse_status",
  "asset_v8_2_cleaned",
  "filing_id",
  "amount_min",
  "amount_max",
  "amount_category",
  "original_pdf_url"
)

read_csv_header_names <- function(path) {
  tryCatch(
    names(
      readr::read_csv(
        path,
        n_max = 0,
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        progress = FALSE
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) character()
  )
}

ptr_file_is_compatible <- function(path) {
  header_names <- read_csv_header_names(path)

  length(header_names) > 0 &&
    all(required_ptr_columns_for_detection %in% header_names)
}

if (!is.na(ptr_file_override)) {
  if (!file.exists(ptr_file_override)) {
    stop(paste("PTR file not found:", ptr_file_override))
  }

  if (!ptr_file_is_compatible(ptr_file_override)) {
    override_header <- read_csv_header_names(ptr_file_override)
    override_missing <- setdiff(
      required_ptr_columns_for_detection,
      override_header
    )

    stop(
      paste0(
        "The manually selected PTR file is not compatible with this project: ",
        ptr_file_override,
        "\nMissing columns: ",
        paste(override_missing, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  ptr_file <- ptr_file_override

} else {
  ptr_files <- list.files(
    pattern = "^PTR_transactions.*\\.csv$",
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    full.names = FALSE
  )

  if (length(ptr_files) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "No PTR_transactions CSV was found in the same folder as this R Markdown file.\n",
        "Put the 2025 accepted-stock-purchase analysis extract beside the Rmd, or set ptr_file_override near the top."
      )
    )
  }

  compatible_ptr_files <- ptr_files[
    vapply(ptr_files, ptr_file_is_compatible, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(compatible_ptr_files) == 0) {
    candidate_report <- vapply(
      ptr_files,
      function(path) {
        missing_here <- setdiff(
          required_ptr_columns_for_detection,
          read_csv_header_names(path)
        )

        paste0(
          "\n  • ",
          path,
          " — missing: ",
          if (length(missing_here) == 0) {
            "none"
          } else {
            paste(missing_here, collapse = ", ")
          }
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )

    stop(
      paste0(
        "PTR CSV files were found, but none contains the V8.2 fields required by this project.",
        paste(candidate_report, collapse = ""),
        "\n\nUse the frozen 2025 accepted-stock-purchase analysis extract ",
        "or set ptr_file_override near the top of the Rmd."
      )
    )
  }

  # Prefer an explicitly named V8.2 file when more than one compatible copy
  # exists. If there are several V8.2 copies, use the newest modified copy.
  v82_candidates <- compatible_ptr_files[
    grepl("V8[_\\.-]?2", compatible_ptr_files, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ]

  preferred_ptr_files <- if (length(v82_candidates) > 0) {
    v82_candidates
  } else {
    compatible_ptr_files
  }

  if (length(preferred_ptr_files) > 1) {
    file_times <- file.info(preferred_ptr_files)$mtime
    ptr_file <- preferred_ptr_files[
      order(file_times, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)
    ][1]
  } else {
    ptr_file <- preferred_ptr_files[1]
  }

  message("Using PTR file: ", ptr_file)
}

if (!file.exists(ptr_file)) {
  stop(paste("PTR file not found:", ptr_file))
}

committee_file <- NA_character_

if (!is.na(committee_file_override)) {
  committee_file <- committee_file_override
} else {
  committee_files <- list.files(
    pattern = "committee.*\\.csv$",
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (length(committee_files) > 0) {
    # Prefer a filename that explicitly says 2025.
    committee_2025 <- committee_files[grepl("2025", committee_files)]

    if (length(committee_2025) > 0) {
      committee_file <- committee_2025[1]
    } else {

}

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
parse_ptr_date <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  parsed <- as.Date(x, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

  missing <- is.na(parsed)
  if (any(missing)) {
    parsed[missing] <- as.Date(x[missing], format = "%m/%d/%Y")
  }

  missing <- is.na(parsed)
  if (any(missing)) {
    parsed[missing] <- as.Date(x[missing], format = "%m/%d/%y")
  }

  parsed
}

normalize_person_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- vapply(
    x,
    function(person) {
      if (!is.na(person) && grepl(",", person, fixed = TRUE)) {
        pieces <- strsplit(person, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        if (length(pieces) >= 2) {
          person <- paste(paste(pieces[-1], collapse = " "), pieces[1])
        }
      }
      person
    },
    character(1)
  )

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub("\\b(honorable|hon|mr|mrs|ms|dr|rep|representative)\\.?\\b", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b(jr|sr|ii|iii|iv)\\.?\\b", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z ]", " ", x)
  trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x))
}

clean_display_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("^Hon\\.\\s*", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^Honorable\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  trimws(x)
}

first_last_key <- function(x) {
  cleaned <- normalize_person_name(x)

  vapply(
    strsplit(cleaned, " "),
    function(parts) {
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]

      if (length(parts) >= 2) {
        paste(parts[1], parts[length(parts)], sep = "_")
      } else if (length(parts) == 1) {
        parts[1]
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

last_name_label <- function(x) {
  cleaned <- normalize_person_name(x)

  vapply(
    strsplit(cleaned, " "),
    function(parts) {
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
      if (length(parts) == 0) return("")
      tools::toTitleCase(parts[length(parts)])
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

normalize_party <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("d", "dem", "democrat", "democratic", "democratic party") ~ "Democrat",
    x %in% c("r", "rep", "republican", "republican party") ~ "Republican",
    x %in% c("i", "ind", "independent") ~ "Independent",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

spread_y <- function(n, lower = -720, upper = 720) {
  if (n <= 0) return(numeric(0))
  if (n == 1) return(0)
  seq(lower, upper, length.out = n)
}

short_committee_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("^United States House Committee on\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^House Permanent Select Committee on\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^House Select Committee on\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^House Select Subcommittee to Investigate the Remaining Questions Surrounding January 6, 2021$",
            "Jan. 6 Select Subcommittee", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^House Committee on\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^Committee on\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  stringr::str_trunc(x, width = 34, ellipsis = "…")
}

short_subcommittee_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("^Subcommittee on\\s+", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  stringr::str_trunc(x, width = 32, ellipsis = "…")
}

# A few PTR/roster naming differences that otherwise defeat first-last matching.
committee_match_alias <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Daniel Crenshaw" ~ "Dan Crenshaw",
    x == "Greg Steube" ~ "W. Gregory Steube",
    x == "Richard W. Allen" ~ "Rick W. Allen",
    x == "Rob Bresnahan" ~ "Robert P. Bresnahan, Jr.",
    x == "James French Hill" ~ "J. French Hill",
    x == "Valerie Hoyle" ~ "Val T. Hoyle",
    x == "Neal Patrick MD, Facs Dunn" ~ "Neal P. Dunn",
    x == "Peter Allen Stauber" ~ "Pete Stauber",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

  ptr_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,

)

if (length(missing_ptr_columns) > 0) {

}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(

  )

purchases_2025_all <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(transaction_date_parsed),
    format(transaction_date_parsed, "%Y") == as.character(analysis_year),
    transaction_type == "P",
    asset_type == "ST",
    ticker_parse_status == "accepted",
    !is.na(ticker_v8_2_cleaned),

  ) %>%

if (nrow(purchases_2025_all) == 0) {

}

# Count how many different politicians purchased each ticker.
stock_popularity <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  distinct(politician_clean, ticker) %>%
  count(ticker, name = "politician_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(politician_count), ticker)

keep_tickers <- stock_popularity %>%
  filter(politician_count >= min_politicians_per_stock) %>%
  pull(ticker)

purchases_network <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  filter(ticker %in% keep_tickers)

if (nrow(purchases_network) == 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The display filter removed every stock. Lower min_politicians_per_stock (currently ",
      min_politicians_per_stock,
      ")."
    )
  )
}

purchase_edges <- purchases_network %>%
  count(politician_clean, ticker, name = "purchase_count") %>%
  mutate(
    from = paste0("POL_", politician_clean),
    to = paste0("STOCK_", ticker),
    relationship = "purchase",
    width = 0.55 + 0.95 * log1p(purchase_count),
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", politician_clean, " → ", ticker, "</b>",
      "<br>Reported purchase transactions: ", purchase_count
    ),
    color = "rgba(150, 155, 165, 0.16)",
    dashes = FALSE
  )

politicians_in_network <- purchase_edges %>%
  distinct(politician_clean)

# ============================================================
# OPTIONAL 2025 COMMITTEE DATA
# ============================================================
committee_edges <- tibble(
  from = character(),
  to = character(),
  relationship = character(),

  dashes = logical(),

)

# ============================================================
# PARTY LOOKUP FROM PINNED 119TH-CONGRESS ROSTER
# ============================================================
# The setup section builds house_roster_2025_cache_file directly from exact
# unitedstates/congress-legislators source files. Reusing that same pinned
# roster here avoids maintaining duplicate legislator CSVs in this repository.
legislator_roster <- if (file.exists(house_roster_2025_cache_file)) {
  readr::read_csv(
    house_roster_2025_cache_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    transmute(
      full_name = as.character(full_name),
      bioguide_id = as.character(bioguide),
      party = normalize_party(party),
      roster_priority = 1L
    )
} else {
  tibble(
    full_name = character(),
    bioguide_id = character(),
    party = character(),
    roster_priority = integer()
  )
}

legislator_party_by_name <- legislator_roster %>%
  filter(!is.na(full_name), full_name != "") %>%
  mutate(name_key = first_last_key(full_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(name_key)) %>%
  arrange(name_key, roster_priority, desc(party != "Unknown")) %>%
  distinct(name_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(name_key, party)

legislator_party_by_bioguide <- legislator_roster %>%
  filter(!is.na(bioguide_id), bioguide_id != "") %>%
  arrange(bioguide_id, roster_priority, desc(party != "Unknown")) %>%
  distinct(bioguide_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    bioguide = bioguide_id,
    party
  )

politician_party <- politicians_in_network %>%
  mutate(
    party_match_name = committee_match_alias(politician_clean),
    name_key = first_last_key(party_match_name)
  ) %>%
  left_join(legislator_party_by_name, by = "name_key") %>%
  transmute(
    politician_clean,
    party = ifelse(is.na(party), "Unknown", party)
  )

# Party lookup for every accepted 2025 public-stock purchaser.
# The main graph is filtered to shared stocks, but committee/subcommittee
# inspectors use the full accepted 2025 purchase universe.
all_2025_politician_party <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  distinct(politician_clean) %>%
  mutate(
    party_match_name = committee_match_alias(politician_clean),
    name_key = first_last_key(party_match_name)
  ) %>%
  left_join(legislator_party_by_name, by = "name_key") %>%
  transmute(
    politician_clean,
    party = ifelse(is.na(party), "Unknown", party)
  )

committee_nodes_source <- tibble(

  committee_name = character()
)

subcommittee_nodes_source <- tibble(

  parent_committee_id = character(),

)

# Re-initialize all optional institutional edges here so the code
# still works when committee/subcommittee data are unavailable.

committee_roster_for_details <- tibble(
  committee_id = character(),
  committee_name = character(),
  bioguide = character(),
  roster_name = character(),
  first_snapshot = as.Date(character()),

  subcommittee_id = character(),
  subcommittee_name = character(),
  parent_committee_id = character(),
  parent_committee_name = character(),
  bioguide = character(),
  roster_name = character(),
  first_snapshot = as.Date(character()),
  last_snapshot = as.Date(character()),
  snapshots_seen = integer()
)

committee_purchase_rows <- tibble(
  purchase_row_id = integer(),
  politician_clean = character(),
  bioguide = character(),
  ticker = character(),
  transaction_date_parsed = as.Date(character()),
  committee_snapshot_date = as.Date(character()),
  committee_snapshot_match = character(),
  source_commit = character(),
  committee_id = character(),
  committee_name = character()
)

subcommittee_purchase_rows <- tibble(
  purchase_row_id = integer(),
  politician_clean = character(),
  bioguide = character(),
  ticker = character(),
  transaction_date_parsed = as.Date(character()),
  committee_snapshot_date = as.Date(character()),
  committee_snapshot_match = character(),
  source_commit = character(),
  subcommittee_id = character(),
  subcommittee_name = character(),
  parent_committee_id = character(),
  parent_committee_name = character()
)

committee_match_count <- 0L
committee_unmatched_count <- nrow(politicians_in_network)

if (has_committee_file) {
  membership_history <- readr::read_csv(
    committee_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      snapshot_date = as.Date(snapshot_date),
      source_commit = as.character(source_commit),
      committee_type = tolower(
        trimws(as.character(committee_type))
      )
    )

  required_committee_columns <- c(
    "bioguide",
    "name",
    "committee_id",
    "committee_type",
    "committee_name",
    "committee_subcommittee_name",
    "snapshot_date",
    "source_commit"
  )

  missing_committee_columns <- setdiff(
    required_committee_columns,
    names(membership_history)
  )

  if (length(missing_committee_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Time-aware committee file found (",
        committee_file,
        ") but it is missing: ",
        paste(missing_committee_columns, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  membership_history <- membership_history %>%
    filter(
      committee_type %in%
        c("house", "house subcommittee"),
      !is.na(snapshot_date),
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != "",
      !is.na(committee_id),
      committee_id != ""
    )

  # Full 2025 House roster used for robust name -> Bioguide matching and
  # coverage counts, including members who do not appear on a committee.
  house_roster_2025 <- readr::read_csv(
    house_roster_2025_cache_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      bioguide = as.character(bioguide),
      full_name = as.character(full_name),
      party = normalize_party(party),
      name_key = first_last_key(full_name)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != "",
      !is.na(name_key)
    )

  ambiguous_house_name_keys <- house_roster_2025 %>%
    count(name_key) %>%
    filter(n > 1) %>%
    pull(name_key)

  house_roster_unique <- house_roster_2025 %>%
    filter(!name_key %in% ambiguous_house_name_keys) %>%
    distinct(name_key, .keep_all = TRUE)

  ptr_person_match <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    distinct(politician_clean) %>%
    mutate(
      committee_match_name =
        committee_match_alias(politician_clean),
      name_key = first_last_key(
        committee_match_name
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      house_roster_unique %>%
        select(
          bioguide,
          roster_name = full_name,
          name_key
        ),
      by = "name_key"
    )

  # Add Bioguide IDs to every accepted purchase.
  purchases_2025_all <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    left_join(
      ptr_person_match %>%
        select(
          politician_clean,
          bioguide
        ),
      by = "politician_clean"
    )

  # Recreate the display-filtered purchase table so it carries the new
  # Bioguide and snapshot fields added below.
  purchases_network <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    filter(ticker %in% keep_tickers)

  available_snapshot_dates <- sort(
    unique(membership_history$snapshot_date)
  )

  resolve_snapshot_number <- function(date_value) {
    date_value <- as.Date(date_value)

    if (is.na(date_value)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    # Jan. 1-2, 2025 are still part of the 118th Congress.
    if (date_value <= as.Date("2025-01-02")) {
      return(as.numeric(prior_congress_snapshot_date))
    }

    # The 119th Congress began Jan. 3, but the first usable House committee
    # snapshot in this repository is Jan. 21. Use that snapshot for Jan. 3-20.
    if (date_value < first_119_house_snapshot_date) {
      return(as.numeric(first_119_house_snapshot_date))
    }

    earlier_or_same <- available_snapshot_dates[
      available_snapshot_dates <= date_value
    ]

    # From Jan. 21 onward there should always be at least one usable 119th
    # snapshot, but keep a safe fallback in case the index is edited later.
    if (length(earlier_or_same) == 0) {
      return(as.numeric(first_119_house_snapshot_date))
    }

    as.numeric(max(earlier_or_same))
  }

  snapshot_numbers <- vapply(
    purchases_2025_all$transaction_date_parsed,
    resolve_snapshot_number,
    numeric(1)
  )

  purchases_2025_all <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    mutate(
      committee_snapshot_date = as.Date(
        snapshot_numbers,
        origin = "1970-01-01"
      ),
      committee_snapshot_match = dplyr::case_when(
        transaction_date_parsed <= as.Date("2025-01-02") ~
          "Latest usable 118th-Congress snapshot (Dec. 17, 2024)",
        transaction_date_parsed < first_119_house_snapshot_date ~
          "First usable 119th-Congress House snapshot (Jan. 21, 2025)",
        TRUE ~
          "Latest available snapshot on or before transaction date"
      )
    )

  purchases_network <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    filter(ticker %in% keep_tickers)

  # Match each individual purchase to the committee/subcommittee rows that
  # existed in the chosen snapshot for that transaction.
  purchase_membership_matches <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(bioguide),
      !is.na(committee_snapshot_date)
    ) %>%
    select(
      purchase_row_id,
      politician_clean,
      bioguide,
      ticker,
      transaction_date_parsed,
      committee_snapshot_date,
      committee_snapshot_match
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      membership_history,
      by = c(
        "bioguide",
        "committee_snapshot_date" = "snapshot_date"
      )
    )

  committee_purchase_rows <- purchase_membership_matches %>%
    filter(committee_type == "house") %>%
    transmute(
      purchase_row_id,
      politician_clean,
      bioguide,
      ticker,
      transaction_date_parsed,
      committee_snapshot_date,
      committee_snapshot_match,
      source_commit,
      committee_id = as.character(committee_id),
      committee_name = as.character(committee_name)
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  subcommittee_purchase_rows <- purchase_membership_matches %>%
    filter(committee_type == "house subcommittee") %>%
    transmute(
      purchase_row_id,
      politician_clean,
      bioguide,
      ticker,
      transaction_date_parsed,
      committee_snapshot_date,
      committee_snapshot_match,
      source_commit,
      subcommittee_id = as.character(committee_id),
      subcommittee_name =
        as.character(committee_subcommittee_name),
      parent_committee_id =
        substr(as.character(committee_id), 1, 4),
      parent_committee_name =
        as.character(committee_name)
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  # Match-count diagnostics for politicians displayed in the main network.
  politician_match <- politicians_in_network %>%
    left_join(
      ptr_person_match %>%
        select(
          politician_clean,
          bioguide,
          roster_name
        ),
      by = "politician_clean"
    )

  committee_match_count <- sum(
    !is.na(politician_match$bioguide)
  )
  committee_unmatched_count <- sum(
    is.na(politician_match$bioguide)
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # YEAR-LONG ROSTERS FOR DETAIL PANELS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Use the 119th-Congress snapshot history for normal roster context. If a
  # Jan. 1-2 purchase matched the Dec. 17 118th-Congress snapshot, retain that
  # specific purchaser too, without importing the entire prior-Congress roster.
  prior_congress_matched_bioguides <- purchase_membership_matches %>%
    filter(
      committee_snapshot_date == prior_congress_snapshot_date
    ) %>%
    distinct(bioguide) %>%
    pull(bioguide)

  detail_membership_history <- membership_history %>%
    filter(
      snapshot_date >= first_119_house_snapshot_date |
        (
          snapshot_date == prior_congress_snapshot_date &
            bioguide %in% prior_congress_matched_bioguides
        )
    )

  # A member row records the first and last source snapshots in which the
  # member appeared in the detail-history table.
  house_roster_all <- detail_membership_history %>%
    transmute(
      bioguide = as.character(bioguide),
      roster_name = as.character(name),
      name_key = first_last_key(roster_name)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != "",
      !is.na(roster_name),
      roster_name != "",
      !is.na(name_key)
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  committee_roster_for_details <- detail_membership_history %>%
    filter(committee_type == "house") %>%
    group_by(
      committee_id,
      committee_name,
      bioguide
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      roster_name = dplyr::last(
        name[order(snapshot_date)]
      ),
      first_snapshot = min(snapshot_date),
      last_snapshot = max(snapshot_date),
      snapshots_seen = n_distinct(snapshot_date),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      committee_name,
      roster_name
    )

  subcommittee_roster_for_details <- detail_membership_history %>%
    filter(
      committee_type == "house subcommittee"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      subcommittee_id = as.character(committee_id),
      subcommittee_name =
        as.character(committee_subcommittee_name),
      parent_committee_id =
        substr(as.character(committee_id), 1, 4),
      parent_committee_name =
        as.character(committee_name)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      subcommittee_id,
      subcommittee_name,
      parent_committee_id,
      parent_committee_name,
      bioguide
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      roster_name = dplyr::last(
        name[order(snapshot_date)]
      ),
      first_snapshot = min(snapshot_date),
      last_snapshot = max(snapshot_date),
      snapshots_seen = n_distinct(snapshot_date),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      parent_committee_name,
      subcommittee_name,
      roster_name
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # GRAPH EDGES: only when at least one accepted 2025 purchase
  # matched while the politician appeared on that institution
  # in the transaction's chosen snapshot.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  network_politicians <- politicians_in_network$politician_clean

  committee_edges <- committee_purchase_rows %>%
    filter(
      politician_clean %in% network_politicians
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      politician_clean,
      committee_id,
      committee_name
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      matched_purchase_count = n_distinct(
        purchase_row_id
      ),
      first_matched_purchase =
        min(transaction_date_parsed),
      last_matched_purchase =
        max(transaction_date_parsed),
      matched_snapshot_count =
        n_distinct(committee_snapshot_date),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      from = paste0("POL_", politician_clean),
      to = paste0("COMMITTEE_", committee_id),
      relationship = "committee",
      width = 1.15,
      title = paste0(
        "<b>", politician_clean, " → ",
        committee_name, "</b>",
        "<br>",
        matched_purchase_count,
        " accepted 2025 purchase record",
        ifelse(
          matched_purchase_count == 1,
          "",
          "s"
        ),
        " matched while this committee assignment ",
        "appeared in the transaction-date snapshot",
        "<br>Matched purchase span: ",
        format(first_matched_purchase, "%b %d"),
        " – ",
        format(last_matched_purchase, "%b %d, %Y")
      ),
      color = "rgba(82, 112, 99, 0.24)",
      dashes = TRUE
    )

  committee_nodes_source <- committee_edges %>%
    distinct(
      committee_id,
      committee_name
    )

  subcommittee_edges <- subcommittee_purchase_rows %>%
    filter(
      politician_clean %in% network_politicians
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      politician_clean,
      subcommittee_id,
      subcommittee_name,
      parent_committee_id,
      parent_committee_name
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      matched_purchase_count = n_distinct(
        purchase_row_id
      ),
      first_matched_purchase =
        min(transaction_date_parsed),
      last_matched_purchase =
        max(transaction_date_parsed),
      matched_snapshot_count =
        n_distinct(committee_snapshot_date),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      from = paste0("POL_", politician_clean),
      to = paste0(
        "SUBCOMMITTEE_",
        subcommittee_id
      ),
      relationship = "subcommittee",
      width = 0.9,
      title = paste0(
        "<b>", politician_clean, " → ",
        subcommittee_name, "</b>",
        "<br>Subcommittee of ",
        parent_committee_name,
        "<br>",
        matched_purchase_count,
        " accepted 2025 purchase record",
        ifelse(
          matched_purchase_count == 1,
          "",
          "s"
        ),
        " matched while this assignment appeared ",
        "in the transaction-date snapshot"
      ),
      color = "rgba(116, 145, 132, 0.20)",
      dashes = TRUE
    )

  subcommittee_nodes_source <- subcommittee_edges %>%
    distinct(
      subcommittee_id,
      subcommittee_name,
      parent_committee_id,
      parent_committee_name
    )

  committee_nodes_source <- bind_rows(
    committee_nodes_source,
    subcommittee_nodes_source %>%
      transmute(
        committee_id = parent_committee_id,
        committee_name = parent_committee_name
      )
  ) %>%
    distinct(
      committee_id,
      committee_name
    )

  committee_subcommittee_edges <-
    subcommittee_nodes_source %>%
    distinct(
      parent_committee_id,
      parent_committee_name,
      subcommittee_id,
      subcommittee_name
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      from = paste0(
        "COMMITTEE_",
        parent_committee_id
      ),
      to = paste0(
        "SUBCOMMITTEE_",
        subcommittee_id
      ),
      relationship = "committee_hierarchy",
      width = 0.75,
      title = paste0(
        "<b>", parent_committee_name, "</b>",
        "<br>Subcommittee: ",
        subcommittee_name
      ),
      color = "rgba(96, 120, 109, 0.22)",
      dashes = TRUE
    )
}

# ============================================================
# COLOR PURCHASE EDGES BY POLITICIAN PARTY
# ============================================================
# The lines now carry the same party encoding as the politician nodes.
# Transparency lets overlapping edges build into visible red/blue bundles
# without turning the middle of the network into a solid block.
purchase_edges <- purchase_edges %>%
  left_join(politician_party, by = "politician_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    party = ifelse(is.na(party), "Unknown", party),
    color = dplyr::case_when(
      party == "Democrat" ~ "rgba(47, 111, 219, 0.30)",
      party == "Republican" ~ "rgba(214, 75, 75, 0.30)",
      party == "Independent" ~ "rgba(138, 99, 184, 0.26)",
      TRUE ~ "rgba(130, 135, 145, 0.14)"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# STOCK CLICK-DETAIL DATA
# ============================================================
# The CSV already contains enough information for a useful stock inspector:
# cleaned company/asset name, transaction date, reported amount range,
# politician, filing ID, and a link back to the original House PTR PDF.
# Notification date is deliberately NOT used in the click panel because some
# rows in this dataset are flagged for implausible notification dates.

format_dollars <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out <- rep("Not available", length(x))
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  out[ok] <- paste0(
    "$",
    format(round(x[ok]), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  )
  out
}

most_common_nonblank <- function(x, fallback = "Name unavailable") {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(fallback)
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

stock_detail_rows <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  left_join(all_2025_politician_party, by = "politician_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    party = ifelse(is.na(party), "Unknown", party),
    transaction_date_display = format(transaction_date_parsed, "%b %d, %Y"),
    committee_snapshot_display = ifelse(
      !is.na(committee_snapshot_date),
      format(
        committee_snapshot_date,
        "%b %d, %Y"
      ),
      "Not matched"
    ),
    amount_display = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(amount_category) & trimws(as.character(amount_category)) != "" ~ as.character(amount_category),
      !is.na(amount_min) & !is.na(amount_max) ~ paste0(format_dollars(amount_min), " – ", format_dollars(amount_max)),
      TRUE ~ "Amount not available"
    )
  )

stock_detail_summary <- stock_detail_rows %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  summarise(
    company_name = most_common_nonblank(asset_v8_2_cleaned, ticker[1]),
    politician_count = n_distinct(politician_clean),
    purchase_count = n(),
    filing_count = n_distinct(filing_id),
    first_purchase = min(transaction_date_parsed, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_purchase = max(transaction_date_parsed, na.rm = TRUE),
    disclosed_min = sum(amount_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    disclosed_max = sum(amount_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    democrat_count = n_distinct(politician_clean[party == "Democrat"]),
    republican_count = n_distinct(politician_clean[party == "Republican"]),
    independent_count = n_distinct(politician_clean[party == "Independent"]),
    unknown_count = n_distinct(politician_clean[party == "Unknown"]),
    in_main_network = ticker[1] %in% keep_tickers,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

build_stock_detail_html <- function(ticker_value) {
  summary_row <- stock_detail_summary %>% filter(ticker == ticker_value)
  rows <- stock_detail_rows %>%
    filter(ticker == ticker_value) %>%
    arrange(desc(transaction_date_parsed), politician_clean)

  if (nrow(summary_row) == 0) return("")

  s <- summary_row[1, ]

  party_badges <- c(
    if (s$democrat_count > 0) paste0("<span class='party-pill dem'>", s$democrat_count, " Democrat</span>") else "",
    if (s$republican_count > 0) paste0("<span class='party-pill rep'>", s$republican_count, " Republican</span>") else "",
    if (s$independent_count > 0) paste0("<span class='party-pill ind'>", s$independent_count, " Independent</span>") else "",
    if (s$unknown_count > 0) paste0("<span class='party-pill unk'>", s$unknown_count, " Unknown</span>") else ""
  )
  party_badges <- paste(party_badges[party_badges != ""], collapse = " ")

  transaction_html <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
    r <- rows[i, ]
    party_class <- dplyr::case_when(
      r$party == "Democrat" ~ "dem",
      r$party == "Republican" ~ "rep",
      r$party == "Independent" ~ "ind",
      TRUE ~ "unk"
    )

    source_link <- if (!is.na(r$original_pdf_url) && trimws(r$original_pdf_url) != "") {
      paste0(
        "<a class='ptr-link' href='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(r$original_pdf_url, attribute = TRUE),
        "' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'>PTR PDF ↗</a>"
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    paste0(
      "<div class='transaction-row'>",
        "<span class='party-dot ", party_class, "'></span>",
        "<div class='transaction-main'>",
          "<div class='transaction-politician'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(r$politician_clean), "</div>",
          "<div class='transaction-meta'>",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(r$transaction_date_display),
            " · ", htmltools::htmlEscape(r$amount_display),
            "<br><span class='snapshot-inline'>Committee snapshot used: ",
              htmltools::htmlEscape(r$committee_snapshot_display),
            "</span>",
          "</div>",
        "</div>",
        source_link,
      "</div>"
    )
  }, character(1))

  paste0(
    "<div class='detail-kicker'>PUBLIC STOCK</div>",
    "<div class='detail-title-row'><h2>", htmltools::htmlEscape(ticker_value), "</h2></div>",
    "<div class='detail-company'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(s$company_name), "</div>",
    if (isTRUE(s$in_main_network)) {
      "<div class='network-status shared'>Appears in the main shared-stock network (2+ politicians)</div>"
    } else {
      "<div class='network-status outside'>Outside the main graph: bought by only one politician in the accepted 2025 PTR data</div>"
    },
    "<div class='party-pills'>", party_badges, "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-stat-grid'>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>", format(s$politician_count, big.mark = ","), "</b><span>politicians</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>", format(s$purchase_count, big.mark = ","), "</b><span>purchase records</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>", format(s$filing_count, big.mark = ","), "</b><span>PTR filings</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat wide'><b>", format(s$first_purchase, "%b %d"), " – ", format(s$last_purchase, "%b %d, %Y"), "</b><span>2025 purchase-date span</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat wide'><b>", format_dollars(s$disclosed_min), " – ", format_dollars(s$disclosed_max), "</b><span>sum of disclosed transaction bounds</span></div>",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-section-title'>Reported 2025 purchases</div>",
    "<div class='transaction-list'>", paste(transaction_html, collapse = ""), "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-footnote'>Amounts in PTRs are usually reported as ranges. The total above sums the lower and upper bounds of those ranges; it is not an exact amount invested. Transaction date is used here rather than notification date. Committee relationships are matched by transaction date: Jan. 1-2 uses the Dec. 17, 2024 118th-Congress snapshot; Jan. 3-20 uses the Jan. 21, 2025 first usable 119th-Congress House snapshot; Jan. 21 onward uses the latest available snapshot on or before the transaction date.</div>"
  )
}

stock_detail_map <- setNames(
  lapply(stock_detail_summary$ticker, build_stock_detail_html),
  stock_detail_summary$ticker
)

stock_details_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  stock_detail_map,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  null = "null"
)
stock_details_json <- gsub("</script>", "<\\/script>", stock_details_json, fixed = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# COMMITTEE + SUBCOMMITTEE CLICK-DETAIL DATA
# ============================================================
# IMPORTANT: the >=2-politician rule controls ONLY the main graph.
# Committee and subcommittee inspectors use every accepted 2025 public-stock
# purchase in purchases_2025_all. That means a member can show a ticker even
# when that ticker was bought by only one politician and is therefore omitted
# from the main shared-stock network for readability.

party_class_for_html <- function(party_value) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    party_value == "Democrat" ~ "dem",
    party_value == "Republican" ~ "rep",
    party_value == "Independent" ~ "ind",
    TRUE ~ "unk"
  )
}

# Match every accepted 2025 PTR purchaser to the pinned 2025 House roster.
# This is not limited to people who survive the main graph's 2+ ticker filter.
ptr_name_by_bioguide <- if (
  has_committee_file &&
  exists("ptr_person_match")
) {
  ptr_person_match %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != ""
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      bioguide,
      politician_clean
    )
} else {
  tibble(
    bioguide = character(),
    politician_clean = character()
  )
}

build_shared_member_stocks_html <- function(member_purchase_rows) {
  if (nrow(member_purchase_rows) == 0) {
    return(
      "<div class='shared-stock-empty'>No accepted 2025 public-stock purchases were matched to members of this selected institution.</div>"
    )
  }

  shared_stocks <- member_purchase_rows %>%
    group_by(ticker) %>%
    summarise(
      member_count = n_distinct(politician_clean),
      purchase_record_count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(member_count >= 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(member_count), desc(purchase_record_count), ticker)

  if (nrow(shared_stocks) == 0) {
    return(
      "<div class='shared-stock-empty'>No stock was purchased by two or more matched members of this selected institution in the accepted 2025 PTR data.</div>"
    )
  }

  paste(
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_stocks)), function(i) {
      ticker_value <- shared_stocks$ticker[i]
      member_count_value <- shared_stocks$member_count[i]
      record_count_value <- shared_stocks$purchase_record_count[i]

      # Count each member's purchase records for this ticker so the drawer
      # shows how the total breaks down across politicians.
      buyers <- member_purchase_rows %>%
        filter(ticker == ticker_value) %>%
        count(politician_clean, name = "politician_purchase_count") %>%
        left_join(
          all_2025_politician_party,
          by = "politician_clean"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          party = ifelse(is.na(party), "Unknown", party)
        ) %>%
        arrange(
          desc(politician_purchase_count),
          party,
          politician_clean
        )

      buyer_html <- paste(
        vapply(seq_len(nrow(buyers)), function(j) {
          paste0(
            "<span class='shared-buyer'>",
              "<i class='party-dot ", party_class_for_html(buyers$party[j]), "'></i>",
              "<span class='shared-buyer-name'>",
                htmltools::htmlEscape(buyers$politician_clean[j]),
              "</span>",
              "<b class='shared-buyer-count' title='Purchase records by this politician for this ticker'>×",
                buyers$politician_purchase_count[j],
              "</b>",
            "</span>"
          )
        }, character(1)),
        collapse = ""
      )

      paste0(
        "<div class='shared-stock-row'>",
          "<div class='shared-stock-topline'>",
            "<button class='shared-stock-ticker' type='button' onclick=\"window.showStockDetail('",
              htmltools::htmlEscape(ticker_value, attribute = TRUE),
            "', true)\">",
              htmltools::htmlEscape(ticker_value),
            "</button>",
            "<span class='shared-stock-count'>",
              member_count_value, " members",
              if (record_count_value > member_count_value) {
                paste0(" · ", record_count_value, " purchase records")
              } else {
                ""
              },
            "</span>",
          "</div>",
          "<div class='shared-stock-buyers'>", buyer_html, "</div>",
        "</div>"
      )
    }, character(1)),
    collapse = ""
  )
}

build_member_stock_html <- function(
  display_name,
  party_value,
  ptr_name = NA_character_,
  bioguide_value = NA_character_,
  purchase_source_rows = purchases_2025_all,
  first_snapshot_value = NA,
  last_snapshot_value = NA
) {
  has_ptr_name <- !is.na(ptr_name) && trimws(ptr_name) != ""

  stocks <- if (has_ptr_name) {
    purchase_source_rows %>%
      filter(politician_clean == ptr_name) %>%
      group_by(ticker) %>%
      summarise(
        purchase_count = n_distinct(purchase_row_id),
        matched_snapshot_dates = paste(
          sort(
            unique(
              format(
                committee_snapshot_date[
                  !is.na(committee_snapshot_date)
                ],
                "%Y-%m-%d"
              )
            )
          ),
          collapse = "; "
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        in_main_network = ticker %in% keep_tickers
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(in_main_network), desc(purchase_count), ticker)
  } else {
    tibble(
      ticker = character(),
      purchase_count = integer(),
      in_main_network = logical(),
      matched_snapshot_dates = character()
    )
  }

  stock_chips <- if (nrow(stocks) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(seq_len(nrow(stocks)), function(i) {
        ticker_value <- stocks$ticker[i]
        count_value <- stocks$purchase_count[i]
        is_shared <- isTRUE(stocks$in_main_network[i])

        chip_class <- if (is_shared) "stock-chip shared" else "stock-chip outside"
        chip_title <- if (is_shared) {
          "Shared stock: bought by 2+ politicians in the accepted 2025 PTR data; shown in the main graph"
        } else {
          "Single-politician stock: only this politician bought this ticker in the accepted 2025 PTR data; not shown in the main graph"
        }

        paste0(
          "<button class='", chip_class,
          "' type='button' title='",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(chip_title, attribute = TRUE),
          "' data-export-ticker='",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(ticker_value, attribute = TRUE),
          "' data-export-count='", count_value,
          "' data-export-main='", if (is_shared) "yes" else "no",
          "' data-export-snapshots='",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(
            stocks$matched_snapshot_dates[i],
            attribute = TRUE
          ),
          "' onclick=\"window.showStockDetail('",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(ticker_value, attribute = TRUE),
          "', true)\">",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(ticker_value),
          if (count_value > 1) paste0(" <span>×", count_value, "</span>") else "",
          "</button>"
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<span class='no-stock-note'>No accepted 2025 public-stock purchases found for this member</span>"
  }

  paste0(
    "<div class='institution-member-row export-member-row'",
      " data-network-node-id='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          if (has_ptr_name) paste0("POL_", ptr_name) else "",
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "' data-export-member='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(display_name, attribute = TRUE),
      "' data-export-party='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(party_value, attribute = TRUE),
      "' data-export-bioguide='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          ifelse(is.na(bioguide_value), "", bioguide_value),
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "' data-export-has-purchase='yes'",
      " data-export-first-snapshot='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          ifelse(
            is.na(first_snapshot_value),
            "",
            format(
              as.Date(first_snapshot_value),
              "%Y-%m-%d"
            )
          ),
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "' data-export-last-snapshot='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          ifelse(
            is.na(last_snapshot_value),
            "",
            format(
              as.Date(last_snapshot_value),
              "%Y-%m-%d"
            )
          ),
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "'>",
      "<span class='party-dot ", party_class_for_html(party_value), "'></span>",
      "<div class='institution-member-main'>",
        "<div class='institution-member-name'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(display_name), "</div>",
        "<div class='member-stock-chips'>", stock_chips, "</div>",
      "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

build_no_purchase_member_html <- function(
  display_name,
  party_value,
  bioguide_value = NA_character_,
  first_snapshot_value = NA,
  last_snapshot_value = NA
) {
  paste0(
    "<div class='institution-member-row no-purchase-member-row export-member-row'",
      " data-export-member='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(display_name, attribute = TRUE),
      "' data-export-party='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(party_value, attribute = TRUE),
      "' data-export-bioguide='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          ifelse(is.na(bioguide_value), "", bioguide_value),
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "' data-export-has-purchase='no'",
      " data-export-first-snapshot='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          ifelse(
            is.na(first_snapshot_value),
            "",
            format(
              as.Date(first_snapshot_value),
              "%Y-%m-%d"
            )
          ),
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "' data-export-last-snapshot='",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(
          ifelse(
            is.na(last_snapshot_value),
            "",
            format(
              as.Date(last_snapshot_value),
              "%Y-%m-%d"
            )
          ),
          attribute = TRUE
        ),
      "'>",
      "<span class='party-dot ", party_class_for_html(party_value), "'></span>",
      "<div class='institution-member-main'>",
        "<div class='institution-member-name'>",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(display_name),
        "</div>",
      "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

build_committee_detail_html <- function(committee_id_value) {
  matched_purchase_rows <- committee_purchase_rows %>%
    filter(
      committee_id == committee_id_value
    )

  purchaser_bioguides <- matched_purchase_rows %>%
    distinct(bioguide) %>%
    pull(bioguide)

  members <- committee_roster_for_details %>%
    filter(
      committee_id == committee_id_value
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      legislator_party_by_bioguide,
      by = "bioguide"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      ptr_name_by_bioguide,
      by = "bioguide"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      party = ifelse(
        is.na(party),
        "Unknown",
        party
      ),
      display_name = ifelse(
        !is.na(politician_clean) &
          politician_clean != "",
        politician_clean,
        roster_name
      ),
      has_2025_purchase =
        bioguide %in% purchaser_bioguides
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      committee_id,
      committee_name,
      bioguide,
      display_name,
      politician_clean,
      party,
      first_snapshot,
      last_snapshot,
      snapshots_seen,
      has_2025_purchase
    )

  if (nrow(members) == 0) return("")

  committee_name_value <-
    members$committee_name[1]

  purchasers <- members %>%
    filter(has_2025_purchase) %>%
    arrange(
      party,
      display_name
    )

  other_members <- members %>%
    filter(!has_2025_purchase) %>%
    arrange(
      party,
      display_name
    )

  shared_within_committee <-
    matched_purchase_rows %>%
    distinct(
      politician_clean,
      ticker
    ) %>%
    count(
      ticker,
      name = "member_count"
    ) %>%
    filter(member_count >= 2)

  shared_within_committee_html <-
    build_shared_member_stocks_html(
      matched_purchase_rows
    )

  purchaser_html <- if (nrow(purchasers) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(seq_len(nrow(purchasers)), function(i) {
        build_member_stock_html(
          purchasers$display_name[i],
          purchasers$party[i],
          purchasers$politician_clean[i],
          purchasers$bioguide[i],
          matched_purchase_rows,
          purchasers$first_snapshot[i],
          purchasers$last_snapshot[i]
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<div class='shared-stock-empty'>No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase was matched to this committee while the member appeared on the committee in the transaction's selected snapshot.</div>"
  }

  other_member_html <- if (nrow(other_members) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(seq_len(nrow(other_members)), function(i) {
        build_no_purchase_member_html(
          other_members$display_name[i],
          other_members$party[i],
          other_members$bioguide[i],
          other_members$first_snapshot[i],
          other_members$last_snapshot[i]
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<div class='shared-stock-empty'>Every member who appeared on this committee in the available 2025 snapshots had at least one accepted purchase matched while serving in the relevant snapshot.</div>"
  }

  paste0(
    "<div class='detail-kicker institution-kicker'>HOUSE COMMITTEE</div>",
    "<div class='institution-detail-title'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        short_committee_name(
          committee_name_value
        )
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='institution-full-name'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        committee_name_value
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='snapshot-badge'>Time-aware 2025 membership snapshots</div>",

    "<div class='detail-stat-grid institution-stat-grid'>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(members$bioguide),
        "</b><span>members seen in 2025 snapshots</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(purchaser_bioguides),
        "</b><span>members with matched purchases</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(matched_purchase_rows$ticker),
        "</b><span>stocks bought while matched</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        nrow(shared_within_committee),
        "</b><span>stocks bought by 2+ matched members</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        nrow(other_members),
        "</b><span>members with no matched purchase</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(
          matched_purchase_rows$purchase_row_id
        ),
        "</b><span>matched purchase records</span></div>",
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-section-title'>Shared stocks among matched committee members</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-explainer'>",
      "A purchase appears here only when this member appeared on the committee in the membership snapshot selected for that transaction date. ",
      "Jan. 1-2 transactions use the Dec. 17, 2024 118th-Congress snapshot; Jan. 3-20 use the Jan. 21, 2025 first usable 119th-Congress House snapshot; Jan. 21 onward uses the latest available snapshot on or before the transaction date. ",
      "Member names are sorted by purchase-record count for the ticker. While this committee or subcommittee is selected, its matched members stay emphasized and stocks bought by 2+ matched members remain visible as normal yellow stock nodes in the graph.",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-list'>",
      shared_within_committee_html,
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-section-title member-purchase-heading'>Members with time-matched 2025 purchases</div>",
    "<div class='chip-legend' aria-label='Stock chip key'>",
      "<span title='Bought by 2+ politicians in the accepted 2025 PTR data; shown in the main graph'><i class='chip-swatch shared'></i><b>Solid yellow</b>: bought by 2+ politicians</span>",
      "<span title='Only this politician bought the ticker in the accepted 2025 PTR data; not shown in the main graph'><i class='chip-swatch outside'></i><b>Dashed yellow</b>: bought only by this politician</span>",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-explainer'>This key describes each ticker's status in the main House graph, not whether it is shared inside the selected committee or subcommittee. Hover over any ticker for the same explanation.</div>",
    "<div class='institution-member-list'>",
      purchaser_html,
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-section-title no-purchase-heading'>Other members seen in 2025 snapshots</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-explainer'>",
      "These people appeared on this committee in at least one available 2025 snapshot, but this project found no accepted 2025 public-stock purchase that matched to this committee using the transaction-date snapshot rule.",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='institution-member-list no-purchase-list'>",
      other_member_html,
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-footnote'>This is much closer to transaction-date committee membership than a single annual snapshot, but it is still snapshot-based. The repository does not provide a day-by-day membership history, so a committee change between two snapshot dates can only be detected when the next published snapshot appears.</div>"
  )
}

build_subcommittee_detail_html <- function(subcommittee_id_value) {
  matched_purchase_rows <-
    subcommittee_purchase_rows %>%
    filter(
      subcommittee_id ==
        subcommittee_id_value
    )

  purchaser_bioguides <- matched_purchase_rows %>%
    distinct(bioguide) %>%
    pull(bioguide)

  members <- subcommittee_roster_for_details %>%
    filter(
      subcommittee_id ==
        subcommittee_id_value
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      legislator_party_by_bioguide,
      by = "bioguide"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      ptr_name_by_bioguide,
      by = "bioguide"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      party = ifelse(
        is.na(party),
        "Unknown",
        party
      ),
      display_name = ifelse(
        !is.na(politician_clean) &
          politician_clean != "",
        politician_clean,
        roster_name
      ),
      has_2025_purchase =
        bioguide %in% purchaser_bioguides
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      subcommittee_id,
      subcommittee_name,
      parent_committee_id,
      parent_committee_name,
      bioguide,
      display_name,
      politician_clean,
      party,
      first_snapshot,
      last_snapshot,
      snapshots_seen,
      has_2025_purchase
    )

  if (nrow(members) == 0) return("")

  subcommittee_name_value <-
    members$subcommittee_name[1]

  parent_name_value <-
    members$parent_committee_name[1]

  purchasers <- members %>%
    filter(has_2025_purchase) %>%
    arrange(
      party,
      display_name
    )

  other_members <- members %>%
    filter(!has_2025_purchase) %>%
    arrange(
      party,
      display_name
    )

  shared_within_committee <-
    matched_purchase_rows %>%
    distinct(
      politician_clean,
      ticker
    ) %>%
    count(
      ticker,
      name = "member_count"
    ) %>%
    filter(member_count >= 2)

  shared_within_committee_html <-
    build_shared_member_stocks_html(
      matched_purchase_rows
    )

  purchaser_html <- if (nrow(purchasers) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(seq_len(nrow(purchasers)), function(i) {
        build_member_stock_html(
          purchasers$display_name[i],
          purchasers$party[i],
          purchasers$politician_clean[i],
          purchasers$bioguide[i],
          matched_purchase_rows,
          purchasers$first_snapshot[i],
          purchasers$last_snapshot[i]
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<div class='shared-stock-empty'>No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase was matched to this subcommittee while the member appeared on it in the transaction's selected snapshot.</div>"
  }

  other_member_html <- if (nrow(other_members) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(seq_len(nrow(other_members)), function(i) {
        build_no_purchase_member_html(
          other_members$display_name[i],
          other_members$party[i],
          other_members$bioguide[i],
          other_members$first_snapshot[i],
          other_members$last_snapshot[i]
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<div class='shared-stock-empty'>Every member who appeared on this subcommittee in the available 2025 snapshots had at least one accepted purchase matched while serving in the relevant snapshot.</div>"
  }

  paste0(
    "<div class='detail-kicker subcommittee-kicker'>HOUSE SUBCOMMITTEE</div>",
    "<div class='institution-detail-title'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        short_subcommittee_name(
          subcommittee_name_value
        )
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='institution-full-name'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        subcommittee_name_value
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='institution-parent'>Parent committee: ",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        short_committee_name(
          parent_name_value
        )
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='snapshot-badge'>Time-aware 2025 membership snapshots</div>",

    "<div class='detail-stat-grid institution-stat-grid'>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(members$bioguide),
        "</b><span>members seen in 2025 snapshots</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(purchaser_bioguides),
        "</b><span>members with matched purchases</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(matched_purchase_rows$ticker),
        "</b><span>stocks bought while matched</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        nrow(shared_within_committee),
        "</b><span>stocks bought by 2+ matched members</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        nrow(other_members),
        "</b><span>members with no matched purchase</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        n_distinct(
          matched_purchase_rows$purchase_row_id
        ),
        "</b><span>matched purchase records</span></div>",
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-section-title'>Shared stocks among matched subcommittee members</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-explainer'>",
      "A purchase appears here only when this member appeared on the subcommittee in the membership snapshot selected for that transaction date. ",
      "Jan. 1-2 transactions use the Dec. 17, 2024 118th-Congress snapshot; Jan. 3-20 use the Jan. 21, 2025 first usable 119th-Congress House snapshot; Jan. 21 onward uses the latest available snapshot on or before the transaction date. ",
      "Member names are sorted by purchase-record count for the ticker. While this committee or subcommittee is selected, its matched members stay emphasized and stocks bought by 2+ matched members remain visible as normal yellow stock nodes in the graph.",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-list'>",
      shared_within_committee_html,
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-section-title member-purchase-heading'>Members with time-matched 2025 purchases</div>",
    "<div class='chip-legend' aria-label='Stock chip key'>",
      "<span title='Bought by 2+ politicians in the accepted 2025 PTR data; shown in the main graph'><i class='chip-swatch shared'></i><b>Solid yellow</b>: bought by 2+ politicians</span>",
      "<span title='Only this politician bought the ticker in the accepted 2025 PTR data; not shown in the main graph'><i class='chip-swatch outside'></i><b>Dashed yellow</b>: bought only by this politician</span>",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-explainer'>This key describes each ticker's status in the main House graph, not whether it is shared inside the selected committee or subcommittee. Hover over any ticker for the same explanation.</div>",
    "<div class='institution-member-list'>",
      purchaser_html,
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-section-title no-purchase-heading'>Other members seen in 2025 snapshots</div>",
    "<div class='shared-stock-explainer'>",
      "These people appeared on this subcommittee in at least one available 2025 snapshot, but this project found no accepted 2025 public-stock purchase that matched to this subcommittee using the transaction-date snapshot rule.",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='institution-member-list no-purchase-list'>",
      other_member_html,
    "</div>",

    "<div class='detail-footnote'>This is much closer to transaction-date subcommittee membership than a single annual snapshot, but it is still snapshot-based. A membership change between two published snapshots can only be detected when a later snapshot records it.</div>"
  )
}

committee_detail_ids <- unique(committee_roster_for_details$committee_id)
committee_detail_ids <- committee_detail_ids[
  !is.na(committee_detail_ids) & committee_detail_ids != ""
]

committee_detail_map <- if (length(committee_detail_ids) > 0) {

    lapply(committee_detail_ids, build_committee_detail_html),
    committee_detail_ids
  )
} else {
  list()
}

subcommittee_detail_ids <- unique(subcommittee_roster_for_details$subcommittee_id)
subcommittee_detail_ids <- subcommittee_detail_ids[
  !is.na(subcommittee_detail_ids) & subcommittee_detail_ids != ""
]

subcommittee_detail_map <- if (length(subcommittee_detail_ids) > 0) {

    lapply(subcommittee_detail_ids, build_subcommittee_detail_html),
    subcommittee_detail_ids

} else {

committee_details_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  committee_detail_map,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  null = "null"
)
committee_details_json <- gsub("</script>", "<\\/script>", committee_details_json, fixed = TRUE)

subcommittee_details_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  subcommittee_detail_map,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  null = "null"
)
subcommittee_details_json <- gsub("</script>", "<\\/script>", subcommittee_details_json, fixed = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 2025 HOUSE COVERAGE
# ============================================================
# This answers a different question from the graph filter:
#
#   Main network:
#     accepted 2025 public-stock purchaser who bought at least one ticker
#     also bought by another politician.
#
#   Accepted purchases, outside main graph:
#     accepted 2025 public-stock purchaser, but none of their purchased
#     tickers passed the 2+ politician graph filter.
#
#   No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found:
#     a person who served in the House during 2025 but has no accepted
#     public-stock purchase row after this project's filters.
#
# The last category does NOT prove the person did not trade. It can also mean
# sales only, non-stock assets, unresolved/rejected ticker parsing, no qualifying
# PTR filing, or missing/unparsed data.

house_roster_coverage <- if (
  exists("house_roster_2025")
) {
  roster_base <- house_roster_2025 %>%
    select(
      bioguide,
      full_name,
      state,
      district,
      party,
      first_2025_term_date,
      last_2025_term_date,
      name_key
    )

  purchaser_by_bioguide <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != ""
    ) %>%
    group_by(bioguide) %>%
    summarise(
      accepted_purchase_records = n(),
      accepted_stock_count =
        n_distinct(ticker),
      accepted_tickers = paste(
        sort(unique(ticker)),
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      ptr_name = dplyr::first(
        politician_clean
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  main_network_bioguides <-
    purchases_network %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(bioguide),
      bioguide != ""
    ) %>%
    distinct(bioguide) %>%
    pull(bioguide)

  roster_base %>%
    left_join(
      purchaser_by_bioguide,
      by = "bioguide"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      accepted_purchase_records =
        ifelse(
          is.na(accepted_purchase_records),
          0L,
          accepted_purchase_records
        ),
      accepted_stock_count =
        ifelse(
          is.na(accepted_stock_count),
          0L,
          accepted_stock_count
        ),
      accepted_tickers =
        ifelse(
          is.na(accepted_tickers),
          "",
          accepted_tickers
        ),
      coverage_status = case_when(
        bioguide %in%
          main_network_bioguides ~
          "In main shared-stock network",
        accepted_purchase_records > 0 ~
          "Accepted purchases, outside main graph",
        TRUE ~
          "No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found"
      ),
      network_node_id = ifelse(
        bioguide %in%
          main_network_bioguides,
        paste0(
          "POL_",
          ifelse(
            !is.na(ptr_name) &
              ptr_name != "",
            ptr_name,
            full_name
          )
        ),
        ""
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      factor(
        coverage_status,
        levels = c(
          "In main shared-stock network",
          "Accepted purchases, outside main graph",
          "No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found"
        )
      ),
      party,
      full_name
    )
} else {
  tibble(
    bioguide = character(),
    full_name = character(),
    state = character(),
    district = integer(),
    party = character(),
    first_2025_term_date = as.Date(character()),
    last_2025_term_date = as.Date(character()),
    accepted_purchase_records = integer(),
    accepted_stock_count = integer(),
    accepted_tickers = character(),
    ptr_name = character(),
    coverage_status = character(),
    network_node_id = character()
  )
}

institution_matched_purchase_ids <- if (
  exists("purchase_membership_matches")
) {
  unique(
    purchase_membership_matches$purchase_row_id
  )
} else {
  integer()
}

purchases_without_institution_match <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  filter(
    !purchase_row_id %in%
      institution_matched_purchase_ids

  purchases_without_institution_match
)

institution_unmatched_politician_count <- n_distinct(
  purchases_without_institution_match$politician_clean
)

accepted_purchaser_total <- n_distinct(
  purchases_2025_all$politician_clean
)

unmatched_ptr_politicians <- if (

) {
  ptr_person_match %>%
    filter(
      is.na(bioguide) |
        bioguide == ""
    ) %>%
    distinct(politician_clean)
} else {
  tibble(
    politician_clean = character()
  )
}

coverage_counts <- house_roster_coverage %>%
  count(
    coverage_status,
    name = "politician_count"
  )

coverage_count_value <- function(status_value) {
  value <- coverage_counts %>%
    filter(
      coverage_status == status_value
    ) %>%
    pull(politician_count)

  if (length(value) == 0) 0L else value[1]
}

)

coverage_outside_count <- coverage_count_value(

)

)
