```{r setup, include=FALSE}
)

build_person_coverage_html <- function(bioguide_value) {
  person <- house_roster_coverage %>%
    filter(
      bioguide == bioguide_value
    )

  if (nrow(person) == 0) return("")

  p <- person[1, ]

  purchases <- purchases_2025_all %>%
    filter(
      bioguide == bioguide_value
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(transaction_date_parsed),
      ticker
    )

  ticker_html <- if (nrow(purchases) > 0) {
    ticker_summary <- purchases %>%
      count(
        ticker,
        name = "purchase_count"
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        desc(purchase_count),
        ticker
      )

    paste(
      vapply(
        seq_len(nrow(ticker_summary)),
        function(i) {
          paste0(
            "<button class='stock-chip ",
            if (
              ticker_summary$ticker[i] %in% keep_tickers
            ) {
              "shared"
            } else {
              "outside"
            },
            "' type='button' onclick=\"window.showStockDetail('",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              ticker_summary$ticker[i],
              attribute = TRUE
            ),
            "', true)\">",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              ticker_summary$ticker[i]
            ),
            if (
              ticker_summary$purchase_count[i] > 1
            ) {
              paste0(
                " <span>×",
                ticker_summary$purchase_count[i],
                "</span>"
              )
            } else {
              ""
            },
            "</button>"
          )
        },
        character(1)
      ),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<span class='no-stock-note'>No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found after this project's filters.</span>"
  }

  committee_assignments <- committee_roster_for_details %>%
    filter(bioguide == bioguide_value) %>%
    arrange(committee_name)

  committee_html <- if (nrow(committee_assignments) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(
        seq_len(nrow(committee_assignments)),
        function(i) {
          paste0(
            "<button class='institution-chip committee' type='button' ",
            "title='Seen in pinned snapshots from ",
            format(committee_assignments$first_snapshot[i], "%b %d, %Y"),
            " through ",
            format(committee_assignments$last_snapshot[i], "%b %d, %Y"),
            "' onclick=\"window.showCommitteeDetail('",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              committee_assignments$committee_id[i],
              attribute = TRUE
            ),
            "', true)\">",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              short_committee_name(
                committee_assignments$committee_name[i]
              )
            ),
            "</button>"
          )
        },
        character(1)
      ),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<span class='no-stock-note'>No House committee assignment found in the pinned 2025 snapshots used by this project.</span>"
  }

  subcommittee_assignments <- subcommittee_roster_for_details %>%
    filter(bioguide == bioguide_value) %>%
    arrange(parent_committee_name, subcommittee_name)

  subcommittee_html <- if (nrow(subcommittee_assignments) > 0) {
    paste(
      vapply(
        seq_len(nrow(subcommittee_assignments)),
        function(i) {
          paste0(
            "<button class='institution-chip subcommittee' type='button' ",
            "title='",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              subcommittee_assignments$parent_committee_name[i],
              attribute = TRUE
            ),
            " · seen in pinned snapshots from ",
            format(subcommittee_assignments$first_snapshot[i], "%b %d, %Y"),
            " through ",
            format(subcommittee_assignments$last_snapshot[i], "%b %d, %Y"),
            "' onclick=\"window.showSubcommitteeDetail('",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              subcommittee_assignments$subcommittee_id[i],
              attribute = TRUE
            ),
            "', true)\">",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              short_subcommittee_name(
                subcommittee_assignments$subcommittee_name[i]
              )
            ),
            "</button>"
          )
        },
        character(1)
      ),
      collapse = ""
    )
  } else {
    "<span class='no-stock-note'>No House subcommittee assignment found in the pinned 2025 snapshots used by this project.</span>"
  }

  explanation <- if (
    p$coverage_status ==
      "No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found"
  ) {
    paste0(
      "<div class='coverage-warning'>",
      "<b>This does not prove this person made no trades.</b> ",
      "This project is looking specifically for accepted 2025 public-stock purchases. ",
      "A person can land here because they had no qualifying purchase, had only sales or other asset types, had unresolved/rejected ticker parsing, had no qualifying PTR filing, or because source data still need review/scraping.",
      "</div>"
    )
  } else if (
    p$coverage_status ==
      "Accepted purchases, outside main graph"
  ) {
    paste0(
      "<div class='coverage-warning'>",
      "This person has accepted 2025 public-stock purchases in the data, but none of their purchased tickers were bought by at least two politicians, so they are intentionally hidden from the main shared-stock graph.",
      "</div>"
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "<div class='network-status shared'>",
      "Has a stock bought by 2+ politicians",
      "</div>",
      "<div class='network-status-note'>",
      "At least one of this politician's accepted 2025 stock purchases was also reported by another politician, so that ticker appears in the main shared-stock graph.",
      "</div>"
    )
  }

  paste0(
    "<div class='detail-kicker'>2025 HOUSE COVERAGE</div>",
    "<div class='institution-detail-title'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(p$full_name),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='institution-full-name'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        paste0(
          p$party,
          " · ",
          p$state,
          if (
            !is.na(p$district)
          ) {
            paste0("-", p$district)
          } else {
            ""
          }
        )
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='snapshot-badge'>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(
        p$coverage_status
      ),
    "</div>",
    "<div class='person-color-key'>",
      "<div class='person-color-key-title'>What the labels mean</div>",
      "<div class='person-color-key-items'>",
        "<span class='person-key-item'><span class='party-dot dem'></span>Democrat</span>",
        "<span class='person-key-item'><span class='party-dot rep'></span>Republican</span>",
        "<span class='person-key-item'><span class='person-key-pill stock'></span>Stock bought by 2+ politicians</span>",
        "<span class='person-key-item'><span class='person-key-pill stock-outside'></span>Stock bought only by this politician</span>",
        "<span class='person-key-item'><span class='person-key-pill committee'></span>Committee</span>",
        "<span class='person-key-item'><span class='person-key-pill subcommittee'></span>Subcommittee</span>",
      "</div>",
      "<div class='person-color-key-note'>These yellow ticker styles are used only in this detail panel. Solid yellow means the ticker also appears in the main shared-stock graph; dashed yellow means this politician is the only accepted 2025 purchaser of that ticker in the dataset, so it is not shown in the main graph.</div>",
    "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-stat-grid institution-stat-grid'>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        p$accepted_purchase_records,
        "</b><span>accepted purchase records</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat'><b>",
        p$accepted_stock_count,
        "</b><span>accepted stock tickers</span></div>",
      "<div class='detail-stat wide'><b>",
        format(
          as.Date(p$first_2025_term_date),
          "%b %d"
        ),
        " – ",
        format(
          as.Date(p$last_2025_term_date),
          "%b %d, %Y"
        ),
        "</b><span>House service overlapping 2025</span></div>",
    "</div>",
    explanation,
    "<div class='detail-section-title'>Accepted 2025 public stock purchases</div>",
    "<div class='member-stock-chips coverage-stock-chips'>",
      ticker_html,
    "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-section-title person-institution-heading'>House committee assignments seen in 2025 snapshots</div>",
    "<div class='institution-chip-group'>",
      committee_html,
    "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-section-title person-institution-heading'>House subcommittee assignments seen in 2025 snapshots</div>",
    "<div class='institution-chip-group'>",
      subcommittee_html,
    "</div>",
    "<div class='detail-footnote'>Committee and subcommittee listings are snapshot-based. They show assignments observed in the pinned source snapshots used by this project; they are not a perfect day-by-day membership history. Coverage is based on the pinned 2025 House roster plus this project's accepted public-stock-purchase filters. Absence from the purchase data should be treated as a lead for checking, not as proof of no trading.</div>"
  )
}

coverage_button_html <- function(status_value) {
  rows <- house_roster_coverage %>%
    filter(
      coverage_status == status_value
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      party,
      full_name
    )

  if (nrow(rows) == 0) {
    return(
      "<div class='coverage-list-empty'>No politicians in this category.</div>"
    )
  }

  paste(
    vapply(
      seq_len(nrow(rows)),
      function(i) {
        paste0(
          "<button class='coverage-person-button' type='button' onclick=\"window.showCoveragePerson('",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(
            rows$bioguide[i],
            attribute = TRUE
          ),
          "')\">",
          "<span class='party-dot ",
            party_class_for_html(
              rows$party[i]
            ),
          "'></span>",
          "<span>",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(
              rows$full_name[i]
            ),
          "</span>",
          "</button>"
        )
      },
      character(1)
    ),
    collapse = ""
  )
}

coverage_main_html <- coverage_button_html(
  "In main shared-stock network"
)

coverage_outside_html <- coverage_button_html(
  "Accepted purchases, outside main graph"
)

coverage_no_purchase_html <- coverage_button_html(
  "No accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found"
)

# ============================================================
# NODE TABLES
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
politician_nodes <- purchase_edges %>%
  distinct(politician_clean) %>%
  left_join(politician_party, by = "politician_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    party = ifelse(is.na(party), "Unknown", party),
    id = paste0("POL_", politician_clean),
    label = politician_clean,
    group = party,
    full_label = politician_clean
  )

politician_degree <- purchase_edges %>%
  count(from, name = "stock_connections")

politician_nodes <- politician_nodes %>%
  left_join(politician_degree, by = c("id" = "from")) %>%
  mutate(
    stock_connections = ifelse(is.na(stock_connections), 0, stock_connections),
    size = 11 + 1.2 * sqrt(stock_connections),
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", full_label, "</b>",
      "<br>Type: Politician",
      "<br>Party: ", party,
      "<br>Stocks in displayed network: ", stock_connections,
      "<br><i>Click for stocks + committee details</i>"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, label, group, size, title)

stock_nodes <- stock_detail_summary %>%
  filter(ticker %in% keep_tickers) %>%
  arrange(ticker) %>%
  mutate(
    id = paste0("STOCK_", ticker),
    label = ticker,
    group = "Stock",
    size = 10 + 1.6 * sqrt(politician_count),
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", ticker, "</b>",
      "<br>", company_name,
      "<br>Politicians in displayed network: ", politician_count,
      "<br>Reported purchase transactions: ", purchase_count,
      "<br><i>Click for full 2025 transaction details</i>"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, label, group, size, title)

committee_nodes <- committee_nodes_source %>%
  arrange(committee_name) %>%
  distinct(committee_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = paste0("COMMITTEE_", committee_id),
    label = short_committee_name(committee_name),
    group = "Committee",
    size = 12,
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", committee_name, "</b>",
      "<br>Type: House committee"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, label, group, size, title)

subcommittee_nodes <- subcommittee_nodes_source %>%
  arrange(parent_committee_name, subcommittee_name) %>%
  distinct(subcommittee_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = paste0("SUBCOMMITTEE_", subcommittee_id),
    label = short_subcommittee_name(subcommittee_name),
    group = "Subcommittee",
    size = 9,
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", subcommittee_name, "</b>",
      "<br>Type: House subcommittee",
      "<br>Parent: ", parent_committee_name
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, label, group, size, title)

# ============================================================
# SEARCH INDEX
# ============================================================
# One compact client-side index powers the custom search box. It searches
# politician names, tickers/company names, committees, and subcommittees.
search_index <- bind_rows(
  house_roster_coverage %>%
    transmute(
      node_id = network_node_id,
      detail_id = bioguide,
      type = "House member",
      label = full_name,
      secondary = paste0(
        party,
        " · ",
        coverage_status
      ),
      required_view = "current",
      search_text = paste(
        full_name,
        party,
        state,
        district,
        coverage_status
      )
    ),

  stock_detail_summary %>%
    filter(ticker %in% keep_tickers) %>%
    transmute(
      node_id = paste0("STOCK_", ticker),
      detail_id = ticker,
      type = "Stock",
      label = ticker,
      secondary = company_name,
      required_view = "current",
      search_text = paste(ticker, company_name)
    ),

  committee_nodes_source %>%
    distinct(committee_id, committee_name) %>%
    transmute(
      node_id = paste0("COMMITTEE_", committee_id),
      detail_id = committee_id,
      type = "Committee",
      label = short_committee_name(committee_name),
      secondary = committee_name,
      required_view = "committee",
      search_text = paste(
        short_committee_name(committee_name),
        committee_name
      )
    ),

  subcommittee_nodes_source %>%
    distinct(
      subcommittee_id,
      subcommittee_name,
      parent_committee_name
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      node_id = paste0(
        "SUBCOMMITTEE_",
        subcommittee_id
      ),
      detail_id = subcommittee_id,
      type = "Subcommittee",
      label = short_subcommittee_name(
        subcommittee_name
      ),
      secondary = paste0(
        "Parent: ",
        short_committee_name(
          parent_committee_name
        )
      ),
      required_view = "full",
      search_text = paste(
        short_subcommittee_name(
          subcommittee_name
        ),
        subcommittee_name,
        parent_committee_name
      )
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    search_text = tolower(search_text)
  ) %>%
  arrange(type, label)

search_index_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  search_index,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)
search_index_json <- gsub(
  "</script>",
  "<\\/script>",
  search_index_json,
  fixed = TRUE
)

nodes_stock <- bind_rows(
  politician_nodes,
  stock_nodes
) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes_committee <- bind_rows(
  politician_nodes,
  stock_nodes,
  committee_nodes
) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes_subcommittee <- bind_rows(
  politician_nodes,
  stock_nodes,
  committee_nodes,
  subcommittee_nodes
) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

assert_unique_node_ids <- function(nodes, view_name) {
  duplicate_ids <- nodes %>%
    count(id, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Duplicate visNetwork node IDs remain in ",
        view_name,
        ": ",
        paste(duplicate_ids$id, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

assert_unique_node_ids(nodes_stock, "stocks-only view")
assert_unique_node_ids(nodes_committee, "committee view")
assert_unique_node_ids(nodes_subcommittee, "committee + subcommittee view")

edges_stock <- purchase_edges %>%
  select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes)

edges_committee <- bind_rows(
  purchase_edges %>%
    select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes),
  committee_edges %>%
    select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes)
)

edges_subcommittee <- bind_rows(
  purchase_edges %>%
    select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes),
  committee_edges %>%
    select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes),
  subcommittee_edges %>%
    select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes),
  committee_subcommittee_edges %>%
    select(from, to, width, title, color, dashes)
)

# ============================================================
# VISNETWORK FACTORY
# ============================================================
make_network <- function(
  nodes,
  edges,
  include_committees = FALSE,
  view_key = "stock"
) {
  view_key_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(view_key, auto_unbox = TRUE)

  register_network_event <- paste0(
    "function() {",
      "window.networkInstances = window.networkInstances || {};",
      "window.networkInstances[", view_key_json, "] = this;",
    "}"
  )

  stabilization_event <- paste0(
    "function() {",
      "var network = this;",
      "window.networkInstances = window.networkInstances || {};",
      "window.networkInitialPositions = window.networkInitialPositions || {};",
      "window.networkReadyViews = window.networkReadyViews || {};",
      "window.networkInstances[", view_key_json, "] = network;",
      "if (!window.networkInitialPositions[", view_key_json, "]) {",
        "window.networkInitialPositions[", view_key_json, "] = network.getPositions();",
      "}",
      "network.setOptions({physics:false});",
      "window.setTimeout(function() {",
        "try {",
          "var container = network.body && network.body.container;",
          "var host = container ? (container.closest('.network-view') || container.parentElement) : null;",
          "if (host && host.clientWidth > 0 && host.clientHeight > 0) {",
            "var extraTop = document.body.classList.contains('embed-mode') ? 28 : 0;",
            "network.setSize(host.clientWidth + 'px', (host.clientHeight + extraTop) + 'px');",
            "network.redraw();",
            "network.fit({animation:false});",
          "}",
        "} catch (error) {}",
      "}, 120);",
      "window.networkReadyViews[", view_key_json, "] = true;",
      "window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('congress-network-ready-view', {detail:{view:", view_key_json, "}}));",
    "}"
  )

  widget <- visNetwork(
    nodes,
    edges,
    width = "100%",
    height = "850px",
    main = NULL
  ) %>%
    # Start from a reproducible random arrangement, then let physics do the work.
    visLayout(randomSeed = 42) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Democrat",
      color = list(
        background = "#2F6FDB",
        border = "#1F4E9D",
        highlight = list(background = "#2F6FDB", border = "#123D86"),
        hover = list(background = "#3C79E2", border = "#1F4E9D")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#30343A", face = "Arial", size = 11, strokeWidth = 2, strokeColor = "#FFFFFF"),
      shape = "dot"
    ) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Republican",
      color = list(
        background = "#D64B4B",
        border = "#963232",
        highlight = list(background = "#D64B4B", border = "#7A2424"),
        hover = list(background = "#E05A5A", border = "#963232")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#30343A", face = "Arial", size = 11, strokeWidth = 2, strokeColor = "#FFFFFF"),
      shape = "dot"
    ) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Independent",
      color = list(
        background = "#8A63B8",
        border = "#65468A",
        highlight = list(background = "#8A63B8", border = "#50346F"),
        hover = list(background = "#9873C3", border = "#65468A")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#30343A", face = "Arial", size = 11, strokeWidth = 2, strokeColor = "#FFFFFF"),
      shape = "dot"
    ) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Unknown",
      color = list(
        background = "#8A8A8A",
        border = "#5E5E5E",
        highlight = list(background = "#8A8A8A", border = "#454545"),
        hover = list(background = "#999999", border = "#5E5E5E")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#555B64", face = "Arial", size = 11, strokeWidth = 2, strokeColor = "#FFFFFF"),
      shape = "dot"
    ) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Stock",
      color = list(
        background = "#D6B54A",
        border = "#9A7B1D",
        # Keep a selected stock GOLD. A stronger dark border indicates selection
        # without borrowing Democratic blue as a generic selection state.
        highlight = list(background = "#E4C65C", border = "#5F4B12"),
        hover = list(background = "#DFC056", border = "#7A6117")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#5F4B12", face = "Arial", size = 13, strokeWidth = 2, strokeColor = "#FFFFFF"),
      shape = "dot"
    ) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Committee",
      color = list(
        background = "#667A70",
        border = "#42554B",
        highlight = list(background = "#72877C", border = "#2F4138"),
        hover = list(background = "#72877C", border = "#42554B")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#FFFFFF", face = "Arial", size = 12),
      shape = "box"
    ) %>%
    visGroups(
      groupname = "Subcommittee",
      color = list(
        background = "#A8B7AE",
        border = "#667A70",
        highlight = list(background = "#B8C5BD", border = "#4E6257"),
        hover = list(background = "#B4C1B9", border = "#667A70")
      ),
      font = list(color = "#203029", face = "Arial", size = 10),
      shape = "box"
    ) %>%
    visNodes(
      borderWidth = 1.5,
      shadow = FALSE,
      # Keep labels visible much farther out when zooming.
      # visNetwork's default draw threshold makes labels disappear abruptly.
      scaling = list(
        label = list(
          enabled = FALSE,
          drawThreshold = 1,
          maxVisible = 40
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    visEdges(
      smooth = FALSE,
      hoverWidth = 1.15,
      selectionWidth = 1.35
    ) %>%
    # Collision-aware force-directed spaghetti.
    # forceAtlas2Based keeps the organic network shape, while avoidOverlap
    # makes node size part of the repulsion calculation so politician circles
    # do not collapse on top of one another in the dense center.
    visPhysics(
      solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
      forceAtlas2Based = list(
        gravitationalConstant = -85,
        centralGravity = 0.008,
        springLength = 260,
        springConstant = 0.025,
        damping = 0.45,
        avoidOverlap = 1
      ),
      stabilization = list(
        enabled = TRUE,
        iterations = 500,
        fit = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    visInteraction(
      navigationButtons = FALSE,
      keyboard = TRUE,
      zoomView = TRUE,
      dragView = TRUE,
      dragNodes = TRUE,
      hover = TRUE,
      multiselect = TRUE
    ) %>%
    visOptions(
      highlightNearest = list(
        enabled = TRUE,
        degree = 1,
        hover = FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    visEvents(
      # Save a reference to each network so the custom search/reset controls
      # can focus, recenter, and restore its original stabilized layout.
      beforeDrawing = register_network_event,
      afterDrawing = "function(ctx) { if (window.drawInstitutionNativeStocks) { window.drawInstitutionNativeStocks(this, ctx); } }",

      # After the initial layout settles, store the exact starting positions,
      # then stop continuous physics calculations for better performance.
      stabilizationIterationsDone = stabilization_event,

      # Keep the graph visually unchanged while moving it. Hover hit-testing
      # pauses during pan/zoom because it is expensive on this many objects,
      # then resumes as soon as movement stops.
      dragStart = "function(params) { if (!this.__fastMotion) { this.__fastMotion = true; this.setOptions({interaction:{hover:false}}); } }",
      dragEnd = "function(params) { var network = this; window.clearTimeout(network.__fastMotionTimer); network.__fastMotionTimer = window.setTimeout(function() { network.__fastMotion = false; network.setOptions({interaction:{hover:true}}); }, 70); }",
      zoom = "function(params) { var network = this; if (!network.__fastMotion) { network.__fastMotion = true; network.setOptions({interaction:{hover:false}}); } window.clearTimeout(network.__fastMotionTimer); network.__fastMotionTimer = window.setTimeout(function() { network.__fastMotion = false; network.setOptions({interaction:{hover:true}}); }, 110); }",

      selectNode = "function(params) { var id = params.nodes[0]; if (window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork) { window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork(this); } if (typeof id !== 'string') return; if (id.indexOf('STOCK_') === 0 && window.showStockDetail) { window.showStockDetail(id.replace('STOCK_', '')); } else if (id.indexOf('COMMITTEE_') === 0 && window.showCommitteeDetail) { window.showCommitteeDetail(id.replace('COMMITTEE_', '')); } else if (id.indexOf('SUBCOMMITTEE_') === 0 && window.showSubcommitteeDetail) { window.showSubcommitteeDetail(id.replace('SUBCOMMITTEE_', '')); } else if (id.indexOf('POL_') === 0 && window.showPoliticianNodeDetail) { window.showPoliticianNodeDetail(id); } }"
    )

  widget
}

stock_widget <- make_network(
  nodes_stock,
  edges_stock,
  FALSE,
  "stock"
)

committee_widget <- make_network(
  nodes_committee,
  edges_committee,
  TRUE,
  "committee"
)

subcommittee_widget <- make_network(
  nodes_subcommittee,
  edges_subcommittee,
  TRUE,
  "full"
)

# ============================================================
# SUMMARY VALUES FOR THE ABOUT PAGE
# ============================================================
summary_values <- list(
  raw_2025_stock_purchases = nrow(purchases_2025_all),
  raw_2025_politicians = n_distinct(purchases_2025_all$politician_clean),
  raw_2025_tickers = n_distinct(purchases_2025_all$ticker),
  shown_politicians = n_distinct(purchases_network$politician_clean),
  shown_tickers = n_distinct(purchases_network$ticker),
  shown_purchase_edges = nrow(purchase_edges),
  committee_nodes = nrow(committee_nodes),
  committee_edges = nrow(committee_edges),
  subcommittee_nodes = nrow(subcommittee_nodes),
  subcommittee_edges = nrow(subcommittee_edges),
  committee_subcommittee_edges = nrow(committee_subcommittee_edges),
  committee_snapshot_count = nrow(committee_snapshot_index),
  house_coverage_total = coverage_total_count,
  house_coverage_main = coverage_main_count,
  house_coverage_outside = coverage_outside_count,
  house_coverage_no_purchase = coverage_no_purchase_count,
  accepted_purchaser_total = accepted_purchaser_total,
  unmatched_ptr_politicians = nrow(unmatched_ptr_politicians),
  institution_unmatched_purchase_count =
    institution_unmatched_purchase_count,
  institution_unmatched_politician_count =
    institution_unmatched_politician_count
)
```

  line-height: 1.35;
}

.nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.nav-button, .view-button {
  border: 1px solid #d8dce2;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #30343a;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 650;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.16s ease;
}

.nav-button:hover, .view-button:hover {
  background: #f1f3f5;
}

.nav-button.active, .view-button.active {
  background: #17191c;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: #17191c;
}

.page {
  width: 100%;
}

.explore-wrap {
  padding: 16px 28px 34px 28px;
}

.hero-row {
  display: block;
  max-width: 1500px;
  margin: 0 auto 16px auto;
}

.hero-copy h1 {
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1.02;
}

.hero-copy p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #666c75;
  font-size: 15px;
  max-width: 780px;
}

.view-toggle {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.network-toolbar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  right: auto;
  width: min(1320px, calc(100% - 32px));
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 4200;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(205, 210, 216, 0.90);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.91);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(24, 31, 39, 0.12);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  opacity: 0.94;
  transition: opacity .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease;
}

.network-toolbar:hover,
.network-toolbar:focus-within {
  opacity: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 9px 28px rgba(24, 31, 39, 0.14);
}

.network-search-wrap {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 420px;
  min-width: 260px;
  max-width: 560px;
}

.network-view-toggle {
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.network-view-toggle .view-button {
  padding: 8px 11px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.network-tool-actions {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.network-search-input {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: 1px solid #d8dce2;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fbfbfc;
  color: #22262b;
  padding: 10px 38px 10px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  outline: none;
}

.network-search-input:focus {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-color: #aeb5bf;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(60, 68, 78, 0.08);
}

.network-search-clear {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 9px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #7a8088;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}

.network-search-results {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  z-index: 7000;
  max-height: 360px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid #d8dce2;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 38px rgba(20, 28, 38, 0.16);
}

.network-search-results.open {
  display: block;
}

.search-result-item {
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eff1f3;
  background: #ffffff;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.search-result-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.search-result-item:hover,
.search-result-item.active {
  background: #f5f6f8;
}

.search-result-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.search-result-type {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  background: #eef0f2;
  color: #60666f;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.search-result-label {
  min-width: 0;
  color: #202328;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.search-result-secondary {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: #777d85;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.search-empty {
  padding: 11px;
  color: #777d85;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.network-tool-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.network-tool-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 3px;
  border: 1px solid #dfe3e7;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #f4f5f7;
}

.network-tool-button {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #4a5058;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 750;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.network-tool-button:hover {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #202328;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(25, 31, 38, 0.08);
}

.detail-action-button {
  border: 1px solid #d8dce2;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #3f454d;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.detail-action-button:hover {
  background: #f1f3f5;
}

.coverage-card {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  border: 1px solid #e2e5e8;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(20, 28, 38, 0.05);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.coverage-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px 18px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f2;
}

.coverage-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #202328;
}

.coverage-subtitle {
  margin-top: 4px;
  max-width: 760px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #6b7178;
}

.coverage-total {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #f4f5f7;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  text-align: center;
}

.coverage-total b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.coverage-total span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #6d737b;
}

.coverage-filter-check {
  margin: 0 14px 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid #eceff2;
  padding: 10px 4px 0;
  color: #60666e;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.coverage-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px 14px;
}

.coverage-group {
  border: 1px solid #e4e7ea;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fafbfc;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.coverage-group summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 11px 12px;
}

.coverage-group summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.coverage-group-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}

.coverage-group-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #33383f;
}

.coverage-group-count {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  background: #eceff2;
  color: #515860;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.coverage-group-note {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #777d85;
}

.coverage-person-list {
  max-height: 270px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 6px;
  border-top: 1px solid #e7e9ec;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.coverage-person-button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 6px 7px;
  text-align: left;
  color: #40464d;
  font-size: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.coverage-person-button:hover {
  background: #f1f3f5;
}

.coverage-list-empty {
  padding: 8px;
  color: #777d85;
  font-size: 10px;
}

.coverage-warning {
  margin: 12px 0;
  border-left: 3px solid #b8bdc4;
  background: #f6f7f8;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  color: #555c64;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.coverage-stock-chips {
  margin-top: 7px;
}

.snapshot-inline {
  color: #7a8088;
  font-size: 9.5px;
}

.network-card {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e4e8;
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(20, 28, 38, 0.06);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.graph-legend {
  position: absolute;
  top: 76px;
  left: max(16px, calc((100% - 1320px) / 2));
  bottom: auto;
  z-index: 4100;
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px 12px;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  width: max-content;
  max-width: calc(100% - 24px);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(205, 210, 216, 0.90);
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #5f666e;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(24, 31, 39, 0.10);
  backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
  opacity: 0.92;
  transition: opacity .16s ease;
}

.graph-legend:hover {
  opacity: 1;
}

.graph-filter-note {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #4f565f;
}

.legend-dot {
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 5px;
}

.legend-box {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 5px;
}

.legend-box-sub {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 5px;
  border: 1px solid #667A70;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}


.network-view {
  display: none;
  width: 100%;
}

.network-view.active {
  display: block;
}

/* Graph focus mode keeps the controls and detail drawer, but removes the
   surrounding intro content so the network can use the whole screen. */
body.network-focus-mode {
  overflow: hidden;
}

body.network-focus-mode .topbar,
body.network-focus-mode .hero-row {
  display: none !important;
}

body.network-focus-mode #explorePage {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  background: #f6f7f9;
  overflow: hidden;
}

body.network-focus-mode #explorePage.focus-fallback {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9500;
}

body.network-focus-mode .explore-wrap {
  height: 100vh;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

body.network-focus-mode .network-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  border-left: 0;
  border-right: 0;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

body.network-focus-mode .network-toolbar {
  top: 12px;
  left: 50%;
  right: auto;
  width: min(1320px, calc(100% - 24px));
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

body.network-focus-mode .graph-legend {
  top: 70px;
  left: max(12px, calc((100% - 1320px) / 2));
  bottom: auto;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
}

body.network-focus-mode .network-view.active {
  display: block;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
}

body.network-focus-mode .network-view.active .visNetwork {
  height: 100% !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
}

body.network-focus-mode .stock-detail-drawer {
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 24px);
}

.committee-missing {
  margin: 22px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px dashed #c6cbd2;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fafbfc;
  color: #555b64;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.about-wrap {
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 58px 28px 90px 28px;
}

.about-wrap h1 {
  font-size: 42px;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0 0 16px 0;
}

.about-wrap h2 {
  margin-top: 42px;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.about-wrap p, .about-wrap li {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.68;
  color: #40454c;
}

.stat-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 24px 0 34px 0;
}

.stat-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e5e9;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 18px;
}

.stat-number {
  font-size: 27px;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.stat-label {
  color: #707780;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.method-note {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-left: 4px solid #8a9099;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  margin: 22px 0;
}

.file-note {
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 13px;
  background: #eef1f4;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

.code-wrap {
  max-width: 1040px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 52px 28px 90px 28px;
}

.code-wrap h1 {
  font-size: 42px;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0 0 8px 0;
}

.code-wrap h2 {
  margin-top: 40px;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.code-wrap p, .code-wrap li {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.68;
  color: #40454c;
}

.report-meta {
  margin: 10px 0 30px 0;
  color: #69707a;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.r-code-block {
  background: #f3f5f7;
  border: 1px solid #dfe3e8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  white-space: pre;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #22272e;
}

.output-box {
  margin: 12px 0 26px 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e4e8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  color: #43484f;
}

.output-box strong {
  color: #17191c;
}


.stock-detail-drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 86px;
  right: 22px;
  width: min(430px, calc(100vw - 36px));
  max-height: calc(100vh - 110px);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
  border: 1px solid #d9dde3;
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(27, 31, 36, 0.18);
  z-index: 5000;
  display: none;
}

.stock-detail-drawer.open {

}

.stock-detail-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 16px 10px 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eceef1;

}

.stock-detail-header-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.stock-detail-header-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #666d76;

.stock-detail-back {
  display: none;

  padding: 5px 9px;

.stock-detail-back:hover {

}

.stock-detail-close {

.detail-actionbar {

.detail-path {

.party-pill.dem { background:#edf3ff; color:#1F4E9D; border-color:#c8d9ff; }
.party-pill.rep { background:#fff0ed; color:#963232; border-color:#f4cbc4; }
.party-pill.ind { background:#f3eef9; color:#65468A; border-color:#ded0ed; }
.party-pill.unk { background:#f0f1f2; color:#5E5E5E; border-color:#dadcdf; }

.detail-stat-grid {
  display: grid;

  gap: 8px;

}

.detail-stat {

.party-dot.rep { background:#D64B4B; }

.transaction-politician {

.transaction-meta {

.ptr-link {

.detail-footnote {

  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #777d85;

.institution-kicker {

}

.subcommittee-kicker {

.institution-detail-title {

```{r app, echo=FALSE}
  tags$span("Add a House committee-membership CSV beside this Rmd to activate committee layers.")

committee_view_content <- if (has_committee_file && nrow(committee_edges) > 0) {
  committee_widget
} else {
  tags$div(
    class = "committee-missing",
    tags$b("Full committee layer not loaded."),
    tags$br(),
    "The expected columns are ",
    tags$code("bioguide, name, committee_id, committee_name"),
    "."
  )
}

subcommittee_view_content <- if (
  has_committee_file &&
  (nrow(subcommittee_edges) > 0 || nrow(committee_edges) > 0)
) {
  subcommittee_widget
} else {
  tags$div(
    class = "committee-missing",
    tags$b("Subcommittee layer not loaded."),
    tags$br(),
    "For subcommittees the file also needs ",
    tags$code("committee_type"),
    " and ",
    tags$code("committee_subcommittee_name"),
    "."
  )
}

# Load the richest available view first. With the supplied committee file,
# this is the full stock + committee + subcommittee network.
default_view <- if (
  has_committee_file && nrow(subcommittee_edges) > 0
) {
  "full"
} else if (
  has_committee_file && nrow(committee_edges) > 0
) {
  "committee"
} else {
  "stock"
}

Committee and subcommittee relationships are transaction-date-aware. Dragging a node lets the force-directed network settle again; clicking any node opens the detail drawer."

        "No accepted purchase found does not mean no trading. The project filters specifically for accepted public-stock purchases. A member can fall into that group because they had no qualifying purchase, had sales or other asset types instead, had unresolved/rejected ticker parsing, had no qualifying PTR filing, or because the source/scrape still needs review."
      ),

      tags$h2("Important limitation"),
      tags$div(
        class = "method-note",
        "A stock purchase and a committee or subcommittee assignment appearing in the same network are not evidence of misconduct, influence, or causation. The network is an exploratory tool for finding relationships worth checking against original PTR filings and official committee records. The institutional layer uses the closest available 2025 snapshot on or before each transaction date, which is more precise than one annual snapshot. It still should not be treated as proof of a day-by-day assignment because a change can occur between published snapshots. Two members can appear under the same shared stock even if their purchases occurred on different dates."
      ),
```
