  tags$div(
    id = "codePage",
    class = "page",
    style = "display:none;",
    tags$div(
      class = "code-wrap",
      tags$h1("Methodology"),
      tags$div(
        class = "report-meta",
        HTML(
          paste0(
            "<b>2025 Congressional Stock Trading Network</b><br>",
            "Sean Ryan<br>",
            format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$p(
        "This combined Methodology page also serves as the course-format analysis report: explain the step, show the R commands, and then show or describe the resulting output. The Stocks + committees + subcommittees view is the default visualization on the Explore page. Committee data come from the original unitedstates/congress-legislators dataset, were accessed during development through the StrokeOfLuck fork, and use 15 exact pinned 2025 snapshots documented in the packaged snapshot index and plain-language reference note."
      ),

      tags$h2("1. Filter the PTR records"),
      tags$p(
        "First, the PTR data are restricted to transaction dates in 2025, purchase transactions, public stocks, and ticker records that passed the cleaning step."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"ptr <- readr::read_csv(ptr_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

purchases_2025_all <- ptr %>%
  mutate(transaction_date = parse_ptr_date(transaction_date)) %>%
  filter(
    format(transaction_date, \"%Y\") == \"2025\",
    transaction_type == \"P\",
    asset_type == \"ST\",
    ticker_parse_status == \"accepted\",
    !is.na(ticker),
    ticker != \"\"
  )"
        )
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "output-box",
        HTML(
          paste0(
            "<strong>Output:</strong> ",
            format(summary_values$raw_2025_stock_purchases, big.mark = ","),
            " accepted 2025 public-stock purchase records involving ",
            summary_values$raw_2025_politicians,
            " politicians and ",
            format(summary_values$raw_2025_tickers, big.mark = ","),
            " tickers before the network display filter."
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("2. Keep stocks shared by at least two politicians"),
      tags$p(
        "Because the question is who bought the same stocks, a ticker enters the displayed network only when at least two different politicians connect to it."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"shared_stocks <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  distinct(politician_clean, ticker) %>%
  count(ticker, name = \"politician_count\") %>%
  filter(politician_count >= min_politicians_per_stock)

purchases_network <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  semi_join(shared_stocks, by = \"ticker\")"
        )
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "output-box",
        HTML(
          paste0(
            "<strong>Output:</strong> the opening network contains ",
            summary_values$shown_politicians,
            " politicians, ",
            summary_values$shown_tickers,
            " shared stocks, and ",
            format(summary_values$shown_purchase_edges, big.mark = ","),
            " unique politician-to-stock links."
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("3. Encode party as color"),
      tags$p(
        "Party is treated as a visual attribute of the politician node and of that politician's purchase edges. This makes the red and blue bundles readable as political structure rather than decoration."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"purchase_edges <- purchase_edges %>%
  left_join(politician_party, by = \"politician_clean\") %>%
  mutate(
    color = case_when(
      party == \"Democrat\"   ~ \"rgba(47, 111, 219, 0.28)\",
      party == \"Republican\" ~ \"rgba(214, 75, 75, 0.28)\",
      party == \"Independent\"~ \"rgba(138, 99, 184, 0.25)\",
      TRUE                    ~ \"rgba(130, 135, 145, 0.14)\"
    )
  )"
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("4. Build the 2025 committee snapshot history"),
      tags$p(
        "The institutional source is not one annual roster. The project downloads 15 exact 2025 versions of committee-membership-current.yaml and committees-current.yaml from pinned unitedstates/congress-legislators commits. Those snapshots are flattened into one local history table with a snapshot date and source commit attached to every membership row."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"committee_snapshot_index <- tibble::tribble(
  ~snapshot_date, ~source_commit,
  as.Date(\"2024-12-17\"), \"c3843a3...\",
  as.Date(\"2025-01-21\"), \"c9550e5...\",
  as.Date(\"2025-02-02\"), \"fb3faba...\",
  as.Date(\"2025-04-04\"), \"c56f57e...\",
  as.Date(\"2025-06-17\"), \"65259e4...\",
  as.Date(\"2025-09-11\"), \"5de69ba...\",
  as.Date(\"2025-11-14\"), \"c003379...\"
  # plus the other pinned 2025 updates
)

membership_history <- bind_rows(
  lapply(snapshot rows, flatten_house_committee_snapshot)
)"
        )
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "output-box",
        HTML(
          paste0(
            "<strong>Output:</strong> ",
            summary_values$committee_snapshot_count,
            " pinned 2025 committee snapshots are used. The exact dates and commit SHAs are saved in ",
            htmlEscape(committee_snapshot_index_file),
            "."
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("5. Match committee membership to the transaction date"),
      tags$p(
        "Each accepted stock purchase gets one committee snapshot date. Jan. 1-2 uses Dec. 17, 2024 because those dates are still in the 118th Congress. Jan. 3-20 uses Jan. 21, 2025 because the Jan. 17 repository update had no House committee rows. From Jan. 21 onward, the code takes the most recent available snapshot on or before the transaction date. The purchase is then joined only to committee/subcommittee assignments present in that selected snapshot."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"# Example rule:
# Jan. 2 transaction  -> Dec. 17, 2024 snapshot (118th Congress)
# Jan. 10 transaction -> Jan. 21, 2025 snapshot (first usable 119th House snapshot)
# Jul. 10 transaction -> Jun. 17 snapshot
# Oct. 5 transaction  -> Sep. 11 snapshot

purchase_membership_matches <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  inner_join(
    membership_history,
    by = c(
      \"bioguide\",
      \"committee_snapshot_date\" = \"snapshot_date\"
    )
  )

committee_purchase_rows <- purchase_membership_matches %>%
  filter(committee_type == \"house\")

subcommittee_purchase_rows <- purchase_membership_matches %>%
  filter(committee_type == \"house subcommittee\")"
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("6. Keep graph filtering separate from institutional matching"),
      tags$p(
        "The main graph still keeps only stock tickers purchased by at least two different politicians. That filter is for readability. Crucially, stock filtering happens before committee matching: a politician can have no committee assignment and their accepted stock purchases still remain in the stock data. Committee/subcommittee drawers use all accepted purchase records that time-match to the selected institution, including one-person tickers hidden from the main graph."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"main_graph <- purchases_2025_all %>%
  filter(ticker %in% keep_tickers)

committee_detail_purchases <- committee_purchase_rows %>%
  filter(committee_id == selected_committee_id)

# Graph: shared tickers only.
# Committee drawer: all time-matched accepted purchases."
        )
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "output-box",
        HTML(
          paste0(
            "<strong>Validation:</strong> committee matching never removes accepted stock purchases. ",
            summary_values$institution_unmatched_purchase_count,
            " accepted purchase record",
            ifelse(summary_values$institution_unmatched_purchase_count == 1, "", "s"),
            " from ",
            summary_values$institution_unmatched_politician_count,
            " politician",
            ifelse(summary_values$institution_unmatched_politician_count == 1, "", "s"),
            " currently have no committee/subcommittee match in the selected transaction-date snapshot; those purchases remain in the stock data and simply receive no institutional edge. ",
            "PTR-to-roster name matching resolved ",
            summary_values$accepted_purchaser_total - summary_values$unmatched_ptr_politicians,
            "/",
            summary_values$accepted_purchaser_total,
            " accepted purchasers. Of the ",
            summary_values$shown_politicians,
            " politicians in the displayed network, ",
            committee_match_count,
            " matched the committee roster and ",
            committee_unmatched_count,
            " did not."
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("7. Find shared stocks within the selected institution"),
      tags$p(
        "After the time-aware matching is done, a committee or subcommittee drawer groups its matched purchase rows by ticker. A shared institutional stock requires at least two different matched members. Individual member names are then sorted by their number of matched purchase records for that ticker."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"shared_within_committee <- matched_purchase_rows %>%
  distinct(politician_clean, ticker) %>%
  count(ticker, name = \"member_count\") %>%
  filter(member_count >= 2)

buyers <- matched_purchase_rows %>%
  filter(ticker == selected_ticker) %>%
  count(
    politician_clean,
    name = \"politician_purchase_count\"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(politician_purchase_count))"
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("8. Measure House coverage"),
      tags$p(
        "The pinned 119th-Congress House roster (terms overlapping Jan. 3-Dec. 31, 2025) is compared with accepted public-stock purchases. This separates people in the main graph, accepted purchasers hidden only by the 2+ ticker filter, and roster members with no accepted purchase found. The last category is a data-coverage flag, not proof that the member did not trade. Two PTR naming exceptions are handled explicitly for coverage matching: “Neal Patrick MD, Facs Dunn” is mapped to Neal P. Dunn, and “Peter Allen Stauber” is mapped to Pete Stauber."
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "output-box",
        HTML(
          paste0(
            "<strong>Coverage output:</strong> ",
            summary_values$house_coverage_total,
            " House members/delegates served during 2025 in the pinned roster. ",
            summary_values$house_coverage_main,
            " are in the main shared-stock network; ",
            summary_values$house_coverage_outside,
            " have accepted purchases but sit outside the graph filter; ",
            summary_values$house_coverage_no_purchase,
            " have no accepted 2025 public-stock purchase found by this project."
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("9. Add investigation controls"),
      tags$p(
        "The HTML includes a compact search index for graph nodes plus browser-side controls for focusing nodes, fitting the active network back on screen, restoring the originally stabilized layout, preserving drawer drill-down state in the URL, and exporting a selected committee/subcommittee member-by-ticker summary as CSV."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"search_index_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  search_index,
  dataframe = \"rows\",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

# JavaScript keeps a reference to each visNetwork instance and
# stores node positions after the first stabilization.

# Shareable state is written into the URL hash, for example:
#   #view=full&path=committee:HSBA,stock:NVDA

# Committee CSV export is built in the browser from the roster
# and ticker-count data already embedded in the selected drawer."
        )
      ),

      tags$h2("10. Use a collision-aware force-directed layout"),
      tags$p(
        "ForceAtlas2 keeps the exploratory network shape while avoidOverlap reduces circle-on-circle collisions. Stabilization is capped at 500 iterations, and dragging no longer restarts whole-network physics. Edges are drawn as straight lines to reduce visual tangling and lower redraw cost during pan and zoom; hover hit-testing still pauses briefly while the viewer is moving. The lower label draw threshold is unchanged so names stay visible farther out while zooming."
      ),
      tags$pre(
        class = "r-code-block",
        tags$code(
"visNodes(
  borderWidth = 1.5,
  scaling = list(
    label = list(
      enabled = FALSE,
      drawThreshold = 1,
      maxVisible = 40
    )
  )
) %>%
visPhysics(
  solver = \"forceAtlas2Based\",
  forceAtlas2Based = list(
    gravitationalConstant = -85,
    centralGravity = 0.008,
    springLength = 260,
    springConstant = 0.025,
    damping = 0.45,
    avoidOverlap = 1
  ),
  stabilization = list(
    enabled = TRUE,
    iterations = 500,
    fit = TRUE
  )
)"
        )
      ),

      tags$div(
        class = "method-note",
        "The setup/helper code remains hidden because it is long and would interrupt the visualization, but the substantive data filtering, network construction, institutional links, and visualization settings are documented here. The Rmd itself contains the complete executable code."
      ),

      tags$button(
        id = "backToNetworkFromCode",
        class = "nav-button active",
        style = "margin-top:30px;",
        "← Back to network"
      )
    )
  ),


  tags$script(
    HTML(
      paste0(
        "window.stockDetails = ", stock_details_json, ";",
        "window.committeeDetails = ", committee_details_json, ";",
        "window.subcommitteeDetails = ", subcommittee_details_json, ";",
        "window.personDetails = ", person_details_json, ";",
        "window.networkSearchIndex = ", search_index_json, ";",
        "window.defaultNetworkView = ",
          jsonlite::toJSON(default_view, auto_unbox = TRUE),
        ";"
      )
    )
  ),

  tags$script(
    HTML(
      "
      (function() {
        const embedMode =
          new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('embed') === '1';

        document.body.classList.add('explore-page-active');

        if (embedMode) {
          document.body.classList.add('embed-mode');
        }

        const explorePage = document.getElementById('explorePage');
        const aboutPage = document.getElementById('aboutPage');
        const codePage = document.getElementById('codePage');
        const navExplore = document.getElementById('navExplore');
        const navAbout = document.getElementById('navAbout');
        const navCode = document.getElementById('navCode');
        const backToNetwork = document.getElementById('backToNetwork');
        const backToNetworkFromCode = document.getElementById('backToNetworkFromCode');

        const stockOnlyBtn = document.getElementById('stockOnlyBtn');
        const committeeBtn = document.getElementById('committeeBtn');
        const subcommitteeBtn = document.getElementById('subcommitteeBtn');

        const stockView = document.getElementById('stockView');
        const committeeView = document.getElementById('committeeView');
        const subcommitteeView = document.getElementById('subcommitteeView');

        const networkSearchInput = document.getElementById('networkSearchInput');
        const networkSearchClear = document.getElementById('networkSearchClear');
        const networkSearchResults = document.getElementById('networkSearchResults');
        const zoomOutNetworkBtn = document.getElementById('zoomOutNetworkBtn');
        const zoomInNetworkBtn = document.getElementById('zoomInNetworkBtn');
        const recenterNetworkBtn = document.getElementById('recenterNetworkBtn');
        const resetNetworkBtn = document.getElementById('resetNetworkBtn');
        const expandNetworkBtn = document.getElementById('expandNetworkBtn');

        const stockDetailDrawer = document.getElementById('stockDetailDrawer');
        const stockDetailBody = document.getElementById('stockDetailBody');
        const stockDetailClose = document.getElementById('stockDetailClose');
        const detailDrawerBack = document.getElementById('detailDrawerBack');
        const detailDrawerLabel = document.getElementById('detailDrawerLabel');
        const detailDrawerPath = document.getElementById('detailDrawerPath');
        const detailCopyLink = document.getElementById('detailCopyLink');
        const detailExportCsv = document.getElementById('detailExportCsv');

        const stockDetails = window.stockDetails || {};
        const committeeDetails = window.committeeDetails || {};
        const subcommitteeDetails = window.subcommitteeDetails || {};
        const personDetails = window.personDetails || {};
        const searchIndex = Array.isArray(window.networkSearchIndex)
          ? window.networkSearchIndex
          : [];

        window.networkInstances = window.networkInstances || {};
        window.networkInitialPositions = window.networkInitialPositions || {};

        let detailHistory = [];
        let currentDetail = null;
        let searchMatches = [];
        let searchActiveIndex = -1;
        let restoringSharedState = false;

        function getActiveViewKey() {
          if (subcommitteeView.classList.contains('active')) return 'full';
          if (committeeView.classList.contains('active')) return 'committee';
          return 'stock';
        }

        function getActiveNetwork() {
          return window.networkInstances[getActiveViewKey()] || null;
        }

        function fireResize() {
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
          }, 80);
        }

        function updateShareUrl() {
          if (restoringSharedState) return;

          const params = new URLSearchParams();
          params.set('view', getActiveViewKey());

          const pathItems = detailHistory.slice();
          if (currentDetail) pathItems.push(currentDetail);

          const serializable = pathItems.filter(function(item) {
            return item && item.type && item.id;
          });

          if (serializable.length > 0) {
            params.set(
              'path',
              serializable.map(function(item) {
                return item.type + ':' + item.id;
              }).join(',')
            );
          }

          const url = new URL(window.location.href);
          url.hash = params.toString();
          window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.toString());
        }

        function extractDetailTitle(html, fallback) {
          if (!html) return fallback;

          const template = document.createElement('template');
          template.innerHTML = html;

          const titleNode = template.content.querySelector(
            '.institution-detail-title, .detail-title-row h2'
          );

          if (titleNode && titleNode.textContent.trim()) {
            return titleNode.textContent.trim();
          }

          return fallback;
        }

        function updateDetailChrome() {
          const pathItems = detailHistory.slice();
          if (currentDetail) pathItems.push(currentDetail);

          const readable = pathItems
            .map(function(item) {
              return item.displayLabel || item.id || item.label;
            })
            .filter(Boolean);

          detailDrawerPath.textContent =
            readable.length > 0 ? readable.join(' → ') : 'Selection';

          if (detailHistory.length > 0) {
            detailDrawerBack.classList.add('visible');
          } else {
            detailDrawerBack.classList.remove('visible');
          }

          const institution = getInstitutionFromDetailPath();
          if (institution) {
            detailExportCsv.style.display = 'inline-flex';
            detailExportCsv.textContent =
              institution.type === 'committee'
                ? 'Export committee CSV'
                : 'Export subcommittee CSV';
          } else {
            detailExportCsv.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }

        function renderDetail(detail, scrollTop) {
          if (!detail || !detail.html) return;

          detailDrawerLabel.textContent = detail.label;
          stockDetailBody.innerHTML = detail.html;
          stockDetailDrawer.classList.add('open');

          currentDetail = {
            label: detail.label,
            html: detail.html,
            type: detail.type,
            id: detail.id,
            displayLabel: detail.displayLabel
          };

          updateDetailChrome();

          window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            stockDetailBody.scrollTop = scrollTop || 0;
          });
        }

        function openDetailDrawer(detail, pushCurrent, suppressUrl) {
          if (!detail || !detail.html) return;

          if (
            pushCurrent &&
            currentDetail &&
            stockDetailDrawer.classList.contains('open')
          ) {
            detailHistory.push({
              label: currentDetail.label,
              html: currentDetail.html,
              type: currentDetail.type,
              id: currentDetail.id,
              displayLabel: currentDetail.displayLabel,
              scrollTop: stockDetailBody.scrollTop
            });
          } else if (!pushCurrent) {
            detailHistory = [];
          }

          renderDetail(detail, 0);

          if (!suppressUrl) updateShareUrl();
        }

        window.showStockDetail = function(ticker, fromDrawer, suppressUrl) {
          const html = stockDetails[ticker];
          openDetailDrawer(
            {
              label: 'Selected stock',
              html: html,
              type: 'stock',
              id: ticker,
              displayLabel: ticker
            },
            fromDrawer === true,
            suppressUrl === true
          );
        };

        function sharedInstitutionTickers(html) {
          if (!html) return [];

          const template = document.createElement('template');
          template.innerHTML = html;

          return Array.from(
            template.content.querySelectorAll('.shared-stock-ticker')
          )
            .map(function(button) {
              return String(button.textContent || '').trim();
            })
            .filter(Boolean);
        }

        function institutionFocusFromHtml(html) {
          return {
            tickerNodeIds: sharedInstitutionTickers(html)
              .map(function(ticker) {
                return 'STOCK_' + ticker;
              })
          };
        }

        window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork = function(network) {
          if (!network || !network.__institutionFocus) return;

          network.__institutionFocus = null;

          try {
            network.redraw();
          } catch (error) {}
        };

        window.drawInstitutionNativeStocks = function(network, ctx) {
          const focus =
            network && network.__institutionFocus;

          if (
            !focus ||
            !focus.tickerNodeIds ||
            focus.tickerNodeIds.length === 0
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const scale = Math.max(
            0.05,
            Number(network.getScale()) || 1
          );

          ctx.save();

          // The committee fade can leave the canvas context partially
          // transparent. Force these shared-stock nodes back to their ordinary
          // fully opaque Stock appearance.
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
          ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          focus.tickerNodeIds.forEach(function(nodeId) {
            try {
              // This is the same geometry lookup that made the earlier ring
              // test line up correctly with the real stock nodes.
              const box = network.getBoundingBox(nodeId);
              if (!box) return;

              const x = (box.left + box.right) / 2;
              const y = (box.top + box.bottom) / 2;

              const dataSet =
                network.body &&
                network.body.data &&
                network.body.data.nodes;
              const node = dataSet && dataSet.get(nodeId);

              // Use the stock node's actual configured size. The bounding box
              // also includes its ticker label, which made the repaint larger
              // than the original node.
              const radius = node
                ? Number(node.size)
                : NaN;

              if (
                !Number.isFinite(x) ||
                !Number.isFinite(y) ||
                !Number.isFinite(radius) ||
                radius <= 0
              ) {
                return;
              }

              // No special effect: simply cover the faded stock node with the
              // exact normal Stock fill and border.
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.fillStyle = '#D6B54A';
              ctx.fill();
              ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 / scale;
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#9A7B1D';
              ctx.stroke();
            } catch (error) {}
          });

          ctx.restore();
        };

        function highlightInstitutionSharedStocks(type, id, html) {
          const focus = institutionFocusFromHtml(html);

          const institutionNodeId =
            type === 'committee'
              ? 'COMMITTEE_' + id
              : 'SUBCOMMITTEE_' + id;

          withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
            try {
              window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork(network);

              // Select ONLY the committee/subcommittee so unrelated House-wide
              // buyers stay faded.
              network.selectNodes(
                [institutionNodeId],
                false
              );

              network.__institutionFocus = focus;

              // Shared committee stocks are repainted after each draw using
              // the ordinary Stock palette. They stay out of the selection set,
              // so unrelated House-wide buyers remain faded.
              network.redraw();
            } catch (error) {}
          });
        }

        window.showCommitteeDetail = function(
          committeeId,
          fromDrawer,
          suppressUrl
        ) {
          const html = committeeDetails[committeeId];

          openDetailDrawer(
            {
              label: 'Selected committee',
              html: html,
              type: 'committee',
              id: committeeId,
              displayLabel: extractDetailTitle(
                html,
                committeeId
              )
            },
            fromDrawer === true,
            suppressUrl === true
          );

          highlightInstitutionSharedStocks(
            'committee',
            committeeId,
            html
          );
        };

        window.showSubcommitteeDetail = function(
          subcommitteeId,
          fromDrawer,
          suppressUrl
        ) {
          const html = subcommitteeDetails[subcommitteeId];

          openDetailDrawer(
            {
              label: 'Selected subcommittee',
              html: html,
              type: 'subcommittee',
              id: subcommitteeId,
              displayLabel: extractDetailTitle(
                html,
                subcommitteeId
              )
            },
            fromDrawer === true,
            suppressUrl === true
          );

          highlightInstitutionSharedStocks(
            'subcommittee',
            subcommitteeId,
            html
          );
        };

        window.showPersonDetail = function(
          bioguide,
          fromDrawer,
          suppressUrl
        ) {
          const html = personDetails[bioguide];

          openDetailDrawer(
            {
              label: 'Selected politician',
              html: html,
              type: 'person',
              id: bioguide,
              displayLabel: extractDetailTitle(
                html,
                bioguide
              )
            },
            fromDrawer === true,
            suppressUrl === true
          );
        };

        window.showCoveragePerson = function(
          bioguide
        ) {
          showExplore();

          const rosterSearchItem = searchIndex.find(
            function(item) {
              return (
                item.type === 'House member' &&
                item.detail_id === bioguide
              );
            }
          );

          if (
            rosterSearchItem &&
            rosterSearchItem.node_id
          ) {
            window.setTimeout(function() {
              focusNode(
                rosterSearchItem.node_id
              );
            }, 80);
          }

          window.showPersonDetail(
            bioguide,
            false,
            false
          );
        };

        window.showPoliticianNodeDetail = function(nodeId) {
          const rosterSearchItem = searchIndex.find(
            function(item) {
              return (
                item.type === 'House member' &&
                item.node_id === nodeId &&
                item.detail_id
              );
            }
          );

          if (!rosterSearchItem) return;

          window.showPersonDetail(
            rosterSearchItem.detail_id,
            false,
            false
          );
        };

        function goBackInDetailDrawer() {
          if (detailHistory.length === 0) return;

          const previous = detailHistory.pop();

          renderDetail(
            {
              label: previous.label,
              html: previous.html,
              type: previous.type,
              id: previous.id,
              displayLabel: previous.displayLabel
            },
            previous.scrollTop || 0
          );

          updateShareUrl();
        }

        function closeStockDetail(suppressUrl) {
          stockDetailDrawer.classList.remove('open');
          detailHistory = [];
          currentDetail = null;
          updateDetailChrome();

          withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
            try {
              if (window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork) {
                window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork(network);
              }
              network.unselectAll();
            } catch (error) {}
          });

          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 120);

          if (!suppressUrl) updateShareUrl();
        }

        function showExplore() {
          explorePage.style.display = 'block';
          aboutPage.style.display = 'none';
          codePage.style.display = 'none';
          navExplore.classList.add('active');
          navAbout.classList.remove('active');
          navCode.classList.remove('active');
          document.body.classList.add('explore-page-active');
          document.body.classList.toggle('explore-locked', embedMode);
          window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'auto'});
          fireResize();
          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);
        }

        function showAbout() {
          explorePage.style.display = 'none';
          aboutPage.style.display = 'block';
          codePage.style.display = 'none';
          navAbout.classList.add('active');
          navExplore.classList.remove('active');
          navCode.classList.remove('active');
          document.body.classList.remove('explore-page-active');
          document.body.classList.remove('explore-locked');
          window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'auto'});
        }

        function showCode() {
          explorePage.style.display = 'none';
          aboutPage.style.display = 'none';
          codePage.style.display = 'block';
          navCode.classList.add('active');
          navExplore.classList.remove('active');
          navAbout.classList.remove('active');
          document.body.classList.remove('explore-page-active');
          document.body.classList.remove('explore-locked');
          window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'auto'});
        }

        function showStock(suppressUrl) {
          stockView.classList.add('active');
          committeeView.classList.remove('active');
          subcommitteeView.classList.remove('active');

          stockOnlyBtn.classList.add('active');
          committeeBtn.classList.remove('active');
          subcommitteeBtn.classList.remove('active');

          fireResize();
          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);

          if (!suppressUrl) updateShareUrl();
        }

        function showCommittee(suppressUrl) {
          if (committeeBtn.disabled) return;

          committeeView.classList.add('active');
          stockView.classList.remove('active');
          subcommitteeView.classList.remove('active');

          committeeBtn.classList.add('active');
          stockOnlyBtn.classList.remove('active');
          subcommitteeBtn.classList.remove('active');

          fireResize();
          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);

          if (!suppressUrl) updateShareUrl();
        }

        function showSubcommittee(suppressUrl) {
          if (subcommitteeBtn.disabled) return;

          subcommitteeView.classList.add('active');
          stockView.classList.remove('active');
          committeeView.classList.remove('active');

          subcommitteeBtn.classList.add('active');
          stockOnlyBtn.classList.remove('active');
          committeeBtn.classList.remove('active');

          fireResize();
          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);

          if (!suppressUrl) updateShareUrl();
        }

        function showViewByKey(viewKey, suppressUrl) {
          if (viewKey === 'full' && !subcommitteeBtn.disabled) {
            showSubcommittee(suppressUrl);
          } else if (viewKey === 'committee' && !committeeBtn.disabled) {
            showCommittee(suppressUrl);
          } else {
            showStock(suppressUrl);
          }
        }

        function withActiveNetwork(callback, attempt) {
          const network = getActiveNetwork();

          if (network) {
            callback(network);
            return;
          }

          const nextAttempt = (attempt || 0) + 1;
          if (nextAttempt > 15) return;

          window.setTimeout(function() {
            withActiveNetwork(callback, nextAttempt);
          }, 120);
        }

        function syncNetworkCanvasSize(network) {
          try {
            const container = network.body && network.body.container;
            const host = container
              ? (container.closest('.network-view') || container.parentElement)
              : null;

            if (
              !host ||
              host.clientWidth <= 0 ||
              host.clientHeight <= 0
            ) {
              return false;
            }

            network.setSize(
              host.clientWidth + 'px',
              host.clientHeight + 'px'
            );
            return true;
          } catch (error) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        function focusNode(nodeId) {
          withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
            try {
              network.selectNodes([nodeId]);
              network.focus(
                nodeId,
                {
                  scale: 1.32,
                  animation: {
                    duration: 450,
                    easingFunction: 'easeInOutQuad'
                  }
                }
              );
            } catch (error) {
              // Search still opens the detail drawer even if focusing fails.
            }
          });
        }

        function zoomActiveNetwork(multiplier) {
          withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
            try {
              const currentScale = network.getScale();
              const currentPosition = network.getViewPosition();
              const nextScale = Math.max(
                0.08,
                Math.min(5, currentScale * multiplier)
              );

              network.moveTo({
                position: currentPosition,
                scale: nextScale,
                animation: {
                  duration: 90,
                  easingFunction: 'easeInOutQuad'
                }
              });
            } catch (error) {}
          });
        }

        function recenterActiveNetwork() {
          withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
            try {
              syncNetworkCanvasSize(network);
              network.redraw();
              network.fit({
                animation: {
                  duration: 450,
                  easingFunction: 'easeInOutQuad'
                }
              });
            } catch (error) {}
          });
        }

        let resizeFitTimer = null;

        function fitNetworkAfterViewportResize() {
          window.clearTimeout(resizeFitTimer);
          resizeFitTimer = window.setTimeout(function() {
            if (explorePage.style.display === 'none') return;

            withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
              try {
                syncNetworkCanvasSize(network);
                network.redraw();
                network.fit({animation: false});
              } catch (error) {}
            });
          }, 140);
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', fitNetworkAfterViewportResize);

        if (window.ResizeObserver) {
          const graphResizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(function() {
            fitNetworkAfterViewportResize();
          });
          graphResizeObserver.observe(
            explorePage.querySelector('.network-card')
          );
        }

        function resetActiveNetwork() {
          const viewKey = getActiveViewKey();

          withActiveNetwork(function(network) {
            const saved = window.networkInitialPositions[viewKey];

            try {
              network.setOptions({physics: false});
              syncNetworkCanvasSize(network);
              if (window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork) {
                window.clearInstitutionFocusForNetwork(network);
              }
              network.unselectAll();

              if (saved) {
                Object.keys(saved).forEach(function(nodeId) {
                  const position = saved[nodeId];
                  if (
                    position &&
                    Number.isFinite(position.x) &&
                    Number.isFinite(position.y)
                  ) {
                    network.moveNode(
                      nodeId,
                      position.x,
                      position.y
                    );
                  }
                });
              }

              network.fit({
                animation: {
                  duration: 550,
                  easingFunction: 'easeInOutQuad'
                }
              });
            } catch (error) {
              recenterActiveNetwork();
            }
          });
        }

        function normalizeSearch(value) {
          return String(value || '')
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();
        }

        function scoreSearchResult(item, query) {
          const label = normalizeSearch(item.label);
          const secondary = normalizeSearch(item.secondary);
          const haystack = normalizeSearch(item.search_text);

          if (label === query) return 0;
          if (label.indexOf(query) === 0) return 1;
          if (secondary.indexOf(query) === 0) return 2;
          if (label.indexOf(query) >= 0) return 3;
          if (secondary.indexOf(query) >= 0) return 4;
          if (haystack.indexOf(query) >= 0) return 5;
          return 99;
        }

        function closeSearchResults() {
          networkSearchResults.classList.remove('open');
          networkSearchResults.innerHTML = '';
          searchMatches = [];
          searchActiveIndex = -1;
        }

        function renderSearchResults(query) {
          const q = normalizeSearch(query);

          if (!q) {
            closeSearchResults();
            return;
          }

          searchMatches = searchIndex
            .map(function(item) {
              return {
                item: item,
                score: scoreSearchResult(item, q)
              };
            })
            .filter(function(entry) {
              return entry.score < 99;
            })
            .sort(function(a, b) {
              if (a.score !== b.score) return a.score - b.score;
              return String(a.item.label).localeCompare(
                String(b.item.label)
              );
            })
            .slice(0, 10)
            .map(function(entry) {
              return entry.item;
            });

          networkSearchResults.innerHTML = '';
          searchActiveIndex = -1;

          if (searchMatches.length === 0) {
            const empty = document.createElement('div');
            empty.className = 'search-empty';
            empty.textContent = 'No graph matches found.';
            networkSearchResults.appendChild(empty);
            networkSearchResults.classList.add('open');
            return;
          }

          searchMatches.forEach(function(item, index) {
            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'search-result-item';
            button.setAttribute('data-search-index', String(index));

            const top = document.createElement('div');
            top.className = 'search-result-top';

            const type = document.createElement('span');
            type.className = 'search-result-type';
            type.textContent = item.type;

            const label = document.createElement('span');
            label.className = 'search-result-label';
            label.textContent = item.label;

            top.appendChild(type);
            top.appendChild(label);
            button.appendChild(top);

            if (item.secondary) {
              const secondary = document.createElement('div');
              secondary.className = 'search-result-secondary';
              secondary.textContent = item.secondary;
              button.appendChild(secondary);
            }

            button.addEventListener('click', function() {
              selectSearchResult(item);
            });

            networkSearchResults.appendChild(button);
          });

          networkSearchResults.classList.add('open');
        }

        function setSearchActiveIndex(nextIndex) {
          const buttons = Array.from(
            networkSearchResults.querySelectorAll('.search-result-item')
          );

          buttons.forEach(function(button) {
            button.classList.remove('active');
          });

          if (buttons.length === 0) {
            searchActiveIndex = -1;
            return;
          }

          if (nextIndex < 0) nextIndex = buttons.length - 1;
          if (nextIndex >= buttons.length) nextIndex = 0;

          searchActiveIndex = nextIndex;
          buttons[searchActiveIndex].classList.add('active');
          buttons[searchActiveIndex].scrollIntoView({
            block: 'nearest'
          });
        }

        function selectSearchResult(item) {
          closeSearchResults();
          networkSearchInput.value = item.label;

          if (item.required_view === 'full') {
            showSubcommittee(true);
          } else if (
            item.required_view === 'committee' &&
            getActiveViewKey() === 'stock'
          ) {
            showCommittee(true);
          }

          window.setTimeout(function() {
            focusNode(item.node_id);
          }, 120);

          if (item.type === 'House member') {
            if (item.node_id) {
              window.setTimeout(function() {
                focusNode(item.node_id);
              }, 120);
            }

            window.showPersonDetail(
              item.detail_id,
              false,
              true
            );
          } else if (item.type === 'Stock') {
            window.showStockDetail(
              item.detail_id,
              false,
              true
            );
          } else if (item.type === 'Committee') {
            window.showCommitteeDetail(
              item.detail_id,
              false,
              true
            );
          } else if (item.type === 'Subcommittee') {
            window.showSubcommitteeDetail(
              item.detail_id,
              false,
              true
            );
          } else {
            closeStockDetail(true);
          }

          updateShareUrl();
        }

        function getInstitutionFromDetailPath() {
          const items = detailHistory.slice();
          if (currentDetail) items.push(currentDetail);

          for (let i = items.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
            if (
              items[i] &&
              (items[i].type === 'committee' ||
               items[i].type === 'subcommittee')
            ) {
              return items[i];
            }
          }

          return null;
        }

        function copyTextFallback(value) {
          const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
          textarea.value = value;
          textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
          textarea.style.opacity = '0';
          document.body.appendChild(textarea);
          textarea.select();

          try {
            document.execCommand('copy');
          } catch (error) {}

          document.body.removeChild(textarea);
        }

        function copyCurrentLink() {
          updateShareUrl();

          const value = window.location.href;
          const originalText = detailCopyLink.textContent;

          function showCopied() {
            detailCopyLink.textContent = 'Copied';
            window.setTimeout(function() {
              detailCopyLink.textContent = originalText;
            }, 1200);
          }

          if (
            navigator.clipboard &&
            window.isSecureContext
          ) {
            navigator.clipboard
              .writeText(value)
              .then(showCopied)
              .catch(function() {
                copyTextFallback(value);
                showCopied();
              });
          } else {
            copyTextFallback(value);
            showCopied();
          }
        }

        function csvEscape(value) {
          const quote = String.fromCharCode(34);
          const s = value === null || value === undefined
            ? ''
            : String(value);

          if (
            s.indexOf(',') >= 0 ||
            s.indexOf(quote) >= 0 ||
            s.indexOf('\\n') >= 0 ||
            s.indexOf('\\r') >= 0
          ) {
            return quote +
              s.split(quote).join(quote + quote) +
              quote;
          }

          return s;
        }

        function exportInstitutionCsv() {
          const institution = getInstitutionFromDetailPath();
          if (!institution) return;

          const html = institution.type === 'committee'
            ? committeeDetails[institution.id]
            : subcommitteeDetails[institution.id];

          if (!html) return;

          const template = document.createElement('template');
          template.innerHTML = html;

          const memberRows = Array.from(
            template.content.querySelectorAll('.export-member-row')
          );

          const columns = [
            'institution_type',
            'institution_id',
            'institution_name',
            'membership_basis',
            'member_first_snapshot_seen',
            'member_last_snapshot_seen',
            'bioguide',
            'member',
            'party',
            'has_time_matched_accepted_2025_public_stock_purchase',
            'ticker',
            'purchase_records_for_ticker',
            'matched_snapshot_dates',
            'in_main_shared_stock_network'
          ];

          const output = [columns];

          memberRows.forEach(function(row) {
            const base = [
              institution.type,
              institution.id,
              institution.displayLabel || institution.id,
              'Congress-aware rule: Dec. 17, 2024 for Jan. 1-2; Jan. 21, 2025 for Jan. 3-20; latest snapshot on/before transaction from Jan. 21 onward',
              row.dataset.exportFirstSnapshot || '',
              row.dataset.exportLastSnapshot || '',
              row.dataset.exportBioguide || '',
              row.dataset.exportMember || '',
              row.dataset.exportParty || '',
              row.dataset.exportHasPurchase || 'no'
            ];

            const chips = Array.from(
              row.querySelectorAll('[data-export-ticker]')
            );

            if (chips.length === 0) {
              output.push(
                base.concat(['', '0', '', 'no'])
              );
            } else {
              chips.forEach(function(chip) {
                output.push(
                  base.concat([
                    chip.dataset.exportTicker || '',
                    chip.dataset.exportCount || '1',
                    chip.dataset.exportSnapshots || '',
                    chip.dataset.exportMain || 'no'
                  ])
                );
              });
            }
          });

          const csv = output
            .map(function(row) {
              return row.map(csvEscape).join(',');
            })
            .join('\\r\\n');

          const blob = new Blob(
            [csv],
            {type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}
          );

          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const link = document.createElement('a');

          const safeName = String(
            institution.displayLabel || institution.id
          )
            .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '_')
            .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');

          link.href = url;
          link.download =
            (institution.type === 'committee'
              ? 'committee_'
              : 'subcommittee_') +
            (safeName || institution.id) +
            '_2025_time_aware.csv';

          document.body.appendChild(link);
          link.click();
          document.body.removeChild(link);

          window.setTimeout(function() {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          }, 500);
        }

        function parseSharedPath(pathValue) {
          if (!pathValue) return [];

          return pathValue
            .split(',')
            .map(function(piece) {
              const colon = piece.indexOf(':');
              if (colon < 1) return null;

              return {
                type: piece.slice(0, colon),
                id: piece.slice(colon + 1)
              };
            })
            .filter(Boolean);
        }

        function restoreSharedState() {
          const hash = window.location.hash
            ? window.location.hash.slice(1)
            : '';

          if (!hash) {
            updateShareUrl();
            return;
          }

          const params = new URLSearchParams(hash);
          const viewKey =
            params.get('view') ||
            window.defaultNetworkView ||
            'full';

          const pathItems = parseSharedPath(
            params.get('path')
          );

          restoringSharedState = true;

          showViewByKey(viewKey, true);

          pathItems.forEach(function(item, index) {
            const push = index > 0;

            if (item.type === 'stock' && stockDetails[item.id]) {
              window.showStockDetail(
                item.id,
                push,
                true
              );
            } else if (
              item.type === 'committee' &&
              committeeDetails[item.id]
            ) {
              window.showCommitteeDetail(
                item.id,
                push,
                true
              );
            } else if (
              item.type === 'subcommittee' &&
              subcommitteeDetails[item.id]
            ) {
              window.showSubcommitteeDetail(
                item.id,
                push,
                true
              );
            } else if (
              item.type === 'person' &&
              personDetails[item.id]
            ) {
              window.showPersonDetail(
                item.id,
                push,
                true
              );
            }
          });

          restoringSharedState = false;
          updateShareUrl();

          const finalItem = pathItems[pathItems.length - 1];

          if (finalItem) {
            const prefix =
              finalItem.type === 'stock'
                ? 'STOCK_'
                : finalItem.type === 'committee'
                  ? 'COMMITTEE_'
                  : finalItem.type === 'subcommittee'
                    ? 'SUBCOMMITTEE_'
                    : '';

            if (prefix) {
              window.setTimeout(function() {
                focusNode(prefix + finalItem.id);
              }, 500);
            }
          }
        }

        navExplore.addEventListener('click', showExplore);
        navAbout.addEventListener('click', showAbout);
        navCode.addEventListener('click', showCode);
        backToNetwork.addEventListener('click', showExplore);
        backToNetworkFromCode.addEventListener('click', showExplore);

        stockOnlyBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          showStock(false);
        });

        committeeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          showCommittee(false);
        });

        subcommitteeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          showSubcommittee(false);
        });

        function updateExpandButtonLabel() {
          const active =
            document.fullscreenElement === explorePage ||
            explorePage.classList.contains('focus-fallback');

          expandNetworkBtn.textContent = active
            ? 'Exit full screen'
            : 'Full screen';
        }

        function enterGraphFocus() {
          document.body.classList.add('network-focus-mode');

          const fullscreenRequest =
            explorePage.requestFullscreen ||
            explorePage.webkitRequestFullscreen;

          if (fullscreenRequest) {
            Promise.resolve(
              fullscreenRequest.call(explorePage)
            ).catch(function() {
              explorePage.classList.add('focus-fallback');
              updateExpandButtonLabel();
              fireResize();
              window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);
            });
          } else {
            explorePage.classList.add('focus-fallback');
          }

          updateExpandButtonLabel();
          fireResize();
          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);
        }

        function exitGraphFocus() {
          explorePage.classList.remove('focus-fallback');

          if (
            document.fullscreenElement &&
            document.exitFullscreen
          ) {
            document.exitFullscreen();
          } else if (
            document.webkitFullscreenElement &&
            document.webkitExitFullscreen
          ) {
            document.webkitExitFullscreen();
          } else {
            document.body.classList.remove('network-focus-mode');
            updateExpandButtonLabel();
            fireResize();
            window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);
          }
        }

        function toggleGraphFocus() {
          const active =
            document.fullscreenElement === explorePage ||
            explorePage.classList.contains('focus-fallback');

          if (active) {
            exitGraphFocus();
          } else {
            enterGraphFocus();
          }
        }

        function syncGraphFocusState() {
          const fullscreenActive =
            document.fullscreenElement === explorePage ||
            document.webkitFullscreenElement === explorePage;

          if (!fullscreenActive && !explorePage.classList.contains('focus-fallback')) {
            document.body.classList.remove('network-focus-mode');
          }

          updateExpandButtonLabel();
          fireResize();
          window.setTimeout(recenterActiveNetwork, 180);
        }

        document.addEventListener(
          'fullscreenchange',
          syncGraphFocusState
        );

        document.addEventListener(
          'webkitfullscreenchange',
          syncGraphFocusState
        );

        zoomOutNetworkBtn.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function() {
            zoomActiveNetwork(0.8);
          }
        );

        zoomInNetworkBtn.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function() {
            zoomActiveNetwork(1.25);
          }
        );

        recenterNetworkBtn.addEventListener(
          'click',
          recenterActiveNetwork
        );

        resetNetworkBtn.addEventListener(
          'click',
          resetActiveNetwork
        );

        expandNetworkBtn.addEventListener(
          'click',
          toggleGraphFocus
        );

        networkSearchInput.addEventListener(
          'input',
          function() {
            renderSearchResults(networkSearchInput.value);
          }
        );

        networkSearchInput.addEventListener(
          'focus',
          function() {
            if (networkSearchInput.value.trim()) {
              renderSearchResults(networkSearchInput.value);
            }
          }
        );

        networkSearchInput.addEventListener(
          'keydown',
          function(event) {
            if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
              event.preventDefault();
              setSearchActiveIndex(searchActiveIndex + 1);
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
              event.preventDefault();
              setSearchActiveIndex(searchActiveIndex - 1);
            } else if (event.key === 'Enter') {
              if (
                searchActiveIndex >= 0 &&
                searchMatches[searchActiveIndex]
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                selectSearchResult(
                  searchMatches[searchActiveIndex]
                );
              } else if (searchMatches.length > 0) {
                event.preventDefault();
                selectSearchResult(searchMatches[0]);
              }
            } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
              closeSearchResults();
            }
          }
        );

        networkSearchClear.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function() {
            networkSearchInput.value = '';
            closeSearchResults();
            networkSearchInput.focus();
          }
        );

        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function(event) {
            if (
              !networkSearchResults.contains(event.target) &&
              event.target !== networkSearchInput
            ) {
              closeSearchResults();
            }
          }
        );

        detailDrawerBack.addEventListener(
          'click',
          goBackInDetailDrawer
        );

        stockDetailClose.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function() {
            closeStockDetail(false);
          }
        );

        detailCopyLink.addEventListener(
          'click',
          copyCurrentLink
        );

        detailExportCsv.addEventListener(
          'click',
          exportInstitutionCsv
        );

        document.addEventListener(
          'keydown',
          function(event) {
            if (
              event.key === '/' &&
              document.activeElement !== networkSearchInput
            ) {
              const activeTag = document.activeElement
                ? document.activeElement.tagName
                : '';

              if (
                activeTag !== 'INPUT' &&
                activeTag !== 'TEXTAREA'
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                networkSearchInput.focus();
              }
            }

            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
              if (networkSearchResults.classList.contains('open')) {
                closeSearchResults();
              } else if (
                stockDetailDrawer.classList.contains('open')
              ) {
                closeStockDetail(false);
              }
            }

            if (
              event.key === 'Backspace' &&
              stockDetailDrawer.classList.contains('open') &&
              detailHistory.length > 0
            ) {
              const activeTag = document.activeElement
                ? document.activeElement.tagName
                : '';

              if (
                activeTag !== 'INPUT' &&
                activeTag !== 'TEXTAREA'
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                goBackInDetailDrawer();
              }
            }
          }
        );

        restoreSharedState();

        if (embedMode) {
          showExplore();

          window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
            if (event.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
            if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'congress-network-navigate') return;

            if (event.data.page === 'explore') {
              showExplore();
            } else if (event.data.page === 'about') {
              showAbout();
            } else if (event.data.page === 'methodology') {
              showCode();
            }
          });

          window.setTimeout(function() {
            recenterActiveNetwork();
          }, 700);

          let embedReadySent = false;

          function announceEmbedReady() {
            if (embedReadySent) return;
            embedReadySent = true;

            if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
              window.parent.postMessage(
                {
                  type: 'congress-network-ready',
                  view: window.defaultNetworkView
                },
                window.location.origin
              );
            }
          }

          if (
            window.networkReadyViews &&
            window.networkReadyViews[window.defaultNetworkView]
          ) {
            window.setTimeout(announceEmbedReady, 300);
          } else {
            window.addEventListener(
              'congress-network-ready-view',
              function(event) {
                if (
                  event.detail &&
                  event.detail.view === window.defaultNetworkView
                ) {
                  window.setTimeout(announceEmbedReady, 300);
                }
              }
            );
          }
        }
      })();
      "
    )
  )
)
